title: Japanese stocks, ETFs and REITs on the Tokyo Stock Exchange

research.market: Japan: Tokyo Stock Exchange cash equities (domestic stocks on Prime/Standard/Growth, ETFs/ETNs, J-REITs)
research.summary:
Feasible only at the higher capital levels. A Kronos cross-sectional book is workable at about JPY 3M, marginal at JPY 1M and not feasible at JPY 500k. Domestic stocks trade in 100-share units, and no broker exposes odd-lot services (S株, かぶミニ, プチ株, ひと株) through an API. Evidence: kabuステーションAPI officially does not support プチ株 (answer dated 2026-06-15), and moomoo ひと株 is documented for its smartphone app only. At JPY 500k a 10-name book is pushed into low-priced, non-TOPIX500 names whose 1-yen tick costs 20-33 bps, so the only sensible use of JPY 500k is one 1- or 10-unit ETF.

Linux-capable order APIs from FSA-registered brokers:
(a) 立花証券 e支店 API: free; cash and margin trading including shorts; 0 commission on margin trades; public-key login with no phone step since 2026-06. Its demo is unrealistic (fake prices), its market-data terms ban accumulating data, and breaking API versions are frequent.
(b) moomoo証券 OpenAPI and (c) ウィブル証券 OpenAPI: zero or low commissions, but no Japanese-stock shorting and no paper trading in the Japanese market. moomoo's quote-rights page also lists Japanese-market quotes via the API as Unsupported.
(d) IBKR証券 TWS API / IB Gateway: realistic paper account and shorting, but 0.08% per order with a JPY 80 minimum (about 8-16 bps per side at JPY 50-100k orders), and no 特定口座 (the user must file taxes).
kabuステーションAPI (三菱UFJ eスマート証券, the former auカブコム証券) has zero commission via SOR but runs on Windows only. It is force-logged-out every morning and has no automated re-login; a passkey-only login was planned for about end-October 2026.

Costs: TOPIX500 names cost about 5-15 bps round trip at zero-commission brokers (about 2-8 bps in auctions). Low-priced non-TOPIX500 names cost 30-100+ bps.

Data: J-Quants (JPX) is the right source. It has point-in-time listings, includes delisted names, and prices are raw plus adjusted, in JPY. Within JPY 3,000/month only the Light plan fits (JPY 1,650, 5 years). All of Light's history before the seal (about 2021-11 to 2024-06) falls inside Kronos's Japanese pretraining period (2020-01-31 to 2024-06). History before 2020, which Kronos has not seen, needs Standard (JPY 3,300, from about 2016-11) or Premium (JPY 16,500, from 2008-05); either needs approval, and the licence requires deleting the data after a downgrade.

Edge plausibility is low to moderate. Japan has no momentum premium, the classic price-only effect there is short-term reversal, and foreign investors (about 69% of 2023 Prime brokerage volume) and HFT (about 35% of trading value) dominate trading.

Scheduled changes: TSE tick tables switch to a per-stock liquidity basis (STR) on 2027-03-01; a random closing auction starts 2027-10-12; a TSE working group on further lowering investment units started in October 2026.

brokers.broker: 三菱UFJ eスマート証券 (Mitsubishi UFJ eSmart Securities; renamed from auカブコム証券; 関東財務局長(金商)第61号)
brokers.api: kabuステーションAPI (OpenAPI spec v1.5): REST plus PUSH
brokers.api_kind: Local gateway. The Windows desktop app kabuステーション serves REST on http://localhost:18080/kabusapi (production) and :18081 (検証用, verification), plus WebSocket PUSH. It accepts requests only from the same IP/PC as the running app.
brokers.linux: No. kabuステーション is Windows-only. Windows Server is outside the guaranteed environment. Cloud or VM Windows is allowed but unsupported, and cloning disk images is prohibited. A Windows PC, VM or VPS would be needed (cost not researched).
brokers.eligibility: Securities account (free), then the API usage setting via らくらく電子契約 (no paperwork), plus the kabuステーション Professional or Premium plan. Professional requires a margin (信用) or futures/options account AND at least 1 execution in the rolling 前々々月-to-前営業日 window. First-time kabuステーション users get Professional for about 2 months unconditionally. Margin-account approval requires 'sufficient annual income or financial assets' plus a suitable investment objective and experience; no numeric thresholds are published. Margin minimum collateral is JPY 300k. No minimum balance for cash trading.
brokers.paper_env: No realistic paper environment. The verification port 18081 returns fixed values for program checks only, with no fill simulation. A forward test would have to be self-simulated (shadow trading) or run live at minimum size.
brokers.fees: Domestic cash, margin and プチ株 commissions are JPY 0 when SOR routing is chosen. In normal times new API orders must use SOR (code 9) or 東証+ (27), not 東証. Margin, standard plan: 制度信用 buy interest 2.80%/yr, 一般(長期) 2.79%; 貸株料 1.10%/yr; 一般信用 short premium fee is system-set and capped at 1% of the prior close per share per day; デイトレ信用 costs 0% if closed the same day. 名義書換料 JPY 55 per unit for margin longs held over record dates. 事務管理費 11 sen per share per month (JPY 110-1,100) for positions held 1 month or longer. API free.
brokers.limits_and_orders: Orders 10 req/s; info 10 req/s; wallet 10 req/s; 歩み値 (tick history) 2 req/s. At most 50 registered symbols (REST and PUSH combined); PUSH is throttled to 400 ms. Order types: 成行, 指値, 寄成/寄指 (AM/PM), 引成/引指 (AM/PM), 不成, IOC成行/IOC指値, 逆指値. Margin types: 制度, 一般(長期), 一般(デイトレ). Configurable soft one-shot limits. One kabuステーション session per user.
brokers.notes: Odd lots (プチ株): not supported by kabuステーション or the API (official answer 2026-06-15). Forced logout every morning (about 6:00-6:30) and also after network drops (login checked every 3 minutes). There is no automated or API re-login, and the broker says automating passkey login is unsupported, so a human must log in each trading day. The broker announced on 2026-09-14 that login will become passkey-only (target end-October 2026, timing TBD); whether it is live is unknown. Terms: no continuous storage of market data from kabuステーション or the API (temporary storage on the API PC is OK; own order and execution records may be kept); no third-party programs (own code written with AI assistance is acceptable if the user verifies it); do not feed the data to external AI services.

brokers.broker: 立花証券 e支店 (Tachibana Securities; 関東財務局長(金商)第110号)
brokers.api: 立花証券・e支店・API, version v4r10 (released 2026-08-29; v4r9 retired 2026-09-27)
brokers.api_kind: Cloud HTTPS request/response API (JSON over GET or POST, Shift-JIS encoding) plus EVENT I/F (HTTP chunked or WebSocket) for order and fill notices, system status, and real-time board and news.
brokers.linux: Yes. The broker explicitly supports 'Linux + オールPython' and running on cloud servers.
brokers.eligibility: e支店 account. Since v4r9 (2026-05-30) the user enables the API in the web 'お客様情報' screen after a passkey login, then generates and registers a public/private key pair (public-key auth). Phone-number authentication for API logins is no longer needed after 2026-06-27. The second PIN must be sent with every order request. Margin: at least JPY 300k deposited (取引開始基準), 委託保証金率 33% (minimum JPY 300k), additional-margin (追証) triggers, loss-cut at a 15% maintenance ratio.
brokers.paper_env: A demo environment exists (https://demo-kabuka.e-shiten.jp/e_api_v4r10/, login 8:30-27:00) but uses non-real prices. Market orders fill at a flat JPY 100 and limit orders at the limit; there is no 15:30 extension or closing auction. Functional testing only; not usable for a weeks-long forward test.
brokers.fees: API free. Cash, per-order (個別) plan, tax included: up to JPY 100k 77; 200k 99; 500k 187; 1M 341; 1.5M 407; 3M 473. Daily flat plan: up to JPY 120k/day free; 200k 176; 500k 253; 1M 506; 2M 759; 3M 1,012. Margin commission 0; no margin management fee. 買方金利 2.94%/yr for 制度 and 一般 (raised from 2.50% for trades from 2026-10-19); 売方金利 0%; 貸株料 1.15%/yr; 名義書換料 JPY 55 per unit. Odd lots: selling only, at 0.55%.
brokers.limits_and_orders: Flow limit 10 requests/s, described as a design cap the broker cannot serve for all users. Heavy polling (e.g., frequent CLMMfdsGetMarketPrice calls) during 8:00-15:30 is discouraged, and accounts may be warned or suspended. No 'safe' rate is published. Functions: new, modify and cancel (including bulk cancel) for cash and margin orders; holdings and margin positions; buying power; margin ratio; master data; 逆日歩 and 信用残; real-time quotes; about 20 years of daily history (蓄積情報). Exact order-condition codes (寄付/引け/不成/逆指値) were not verified in this screen.
brokers.notes: The most Linux-friendly route that also allows shorting (制度信用). Risks: breaking API versions roughly every 6 months (v4r7 to v4r10 within 2025-2026); Shift-JIS JSON quirks; the terms prohibit accumulating, editing or processing the market data the broker provides, so its 20-year daily history cannot serve as a research dataset; margin interest is rising. Registration number 第110号 per the e支店 site.

brokers.broker: IBKR証券 (Interactive Brokers Securities Japan Inc., IBSJ; 関東財務局長(金商)第187号)
brokers.api: TWS API (socket) through Trader Workstation or IB Gateway; also Client Portal Web API (REST through a local gateway)
brokers.api_kind: Local Java gateway (TWS or IB Gateway) exposing the socket API on localhost (IB Gateway ports 4001 live, 4002 paper); REST through the Client Portal gateway.
brokers.linux: Yes. IB Gateway installers for Linux x86_64 and ARM64 are offered on the IBSJ site.
brokers.eligibility: Japan residents; online application with a registered-mail ID check (about 7 business days); JASDEC registration (about 3 business days) before trading Japanese stocks. A margin account is subject to age, objective and financial checks, and margin is granted while net liquidation value is at least JPY 300k. No 特定口座 (general account only, so the user files their own tax return). A minimum opening deposit for cash accounts was not found on current FAQ pages.
brokers.paper_env: Yes. One paper account (account number DU...) per live account, logged into with the live credentials; fills are simulated. Paper accounts cannot buy market data themselves, so data comes from the live account's subscriptions. Usable for a weeks-long forward test. Realism of TSE auction fills is unverified, and whether funding must come first is the general IBKR rule, unconfirmed for IBSJ.
brokers.fees: Japanese stocks: Fixed 0.08% of trade value, minimum JPY 80 per order, all-in; or Tiered 0.05% (Tier I up to JPY 150M/month), minimum JPY 80, plus exchange and clearing fees. Both include 10% consumption tax. That is 16 bps per side on a JPY 50k order and 8 bps on JPY 100k or more. TSE market data, non-professional: L1 JPY 300/month, L2 JPY 380/month. Margin interest and borrow fees are variable; their levels were not quantified in this screen.
brokers.limits_and_orders: API request pacing equals market-data lines divided by 2 per second (default 50 req/s). Historical data: 60 requests per 10 minutes; 3 pacing violations end the session. Japanese order types: MKT, LMT, STP, STPLMT, MOC, LOC, OPG (opening auction, routed to TSE).
brokers.notes: Japanese stocks can be shorted through the IBSJ margin account (IBSJ stock loan; availability varies). Initial margin is at least 33% (max 3x) and maintenance about 30%. Liquidation is real-time with no margin calls. IBSJ does not apply the TSE exemption for individual short orders of 50 units or fewer. A long and a short in the same stock are not allowed. IB Gateway restarts daily, but needs a manual second-factor (passkey) login weekly. TSE odd lots: unknown (assume not supported).

brokers.broker: moomoo証券 (Moomoo Securities Japan; 関東財務局長(金商)第3335号)
brokers.api: moomoo OpenAPI (OpenD gateway plus SDKs)
brokers.api_kind: Local gateway (OpenD) relaying to moomoo servers over TCP/protobuf; the SDK talks to OpenD.
brokers.linux: Yes. OpenD supports Windows, macOS, CentOS and Ubuntu.
brokers.eligibility: moomoo証券 account opened online; an API questionnaire and agreement on first OpenD login. The OpenAPI trading table lists Japanese stocks, ETFs and REITs as live-tradable for moomoo JP accounts. Japanese stock margin (信用) is not offered at all ('現在取り扱いしておりません').
brokers.paper_env: No. OpenAPI paper trading does not cover the Japanese market (table shows JP stocks/ETFs/REITs paper = X).
brokers.fees: Japanese stocks and ETFs: JPY 0 commission. ひと株 odd lots: JPY 0, market orders only; orders received 14:30:01 to 8:03:00 fill at the morning opening price, orders received 8:03:01 to 14:30:00 fill at the afternoon closing price. 特定口座 available.
brokers.limits_and_orders: place_order: 15 requests per 30 s per account, at least 0.02 s between requests. Japan-specific order types were not verified. Quote rights conflict: the intro page lists Japanese stock/ETF market data as supported, but the quote-rights page says Japanese market quotes are Unsupported. Treat real-time Japanese quotes via the API as unavailable.
brokers.notes: ひと株 is documented for the smartphone app only; API support for odd-lot orders is unknown (assume no). No shorting, so long-only. Market-data rights need confirming before relying on this API.

brokers.broker: ウィブル証券 (Webull Securities (Japan) Co., Ltd.; 関東財務局長(金商)第48号)
brokers.api: Webull JP OpenAPI (Trading API and Market Data API; Python and Java SDKs)
brokers.api_kind: Cloud API: HTTPS REST with HMAC-signed requests, plus MQTT streaming for market data and gRPC for order events.
brokers.linux: Yes. It is a cloud API with a Python 3.8-3.13 SDK.
brokers.eligibility: Account, then an OpenAPI application in the web member area (review takes at least 1-2 business days), then app registration and key generation (SMS code plus trading password); an optional 2FA token. 特定口座 (源泉徴収) supported. No Japanese margin (US margin only).
brokers.paper_env: A test (UAT) environment with shared test accounts for integration. Its usefulness as a market-realistic forward test is unknown, probably not.
brokers.fees: Japanese cash stocks, tax included: up to JPY 50k 55; 100k 99; 200k 115; 1M 275; 1.5M 535; 30M 640; above that 1,070. That is about 10-11 bps per side at JPY 50-100k orders and about 9 bps at JPY 300k.
brokers.limits_and_orders: Place, replace and cancel: 600 per 60 s; balance, positions and order queries: 2 per 2 s; instruments: 10 per 30 s. Japanese stocks: MARKET and LIMIT only (no stop or stop-limit); time in force DAY or GTC.
brokers.notes: Odd-lot support via the API is unknown. Long-only (no Japanese shorting). The API's Japanese-stock features are new and changing quickly in 2026. Cost and availability of Japanese real-time data subscriptions are unknown.

brokers.broker: 楽天証券 (MarketSpeed II RSS) and 岡三証券 (岡三RSS); others
brokers.api: Excel add-ins with order functions (e.g., RssStockOrder); not a REST API
brokers.api_kind: Local Windows desktop app plus Excel (RTD/VBA)
brokers.linux: No (Windows plus Excel).
brokers.eligibility: Broker account plus tool terms (not checked in detail).
brokers.paper_env: None found.
brokers.fees: Broker standard schedules (not checked in this screen).
brokers.notes: Excluded by the Linux constraint. かぶミニ odd-lot ordering via RSS is not documented. かぶミニ is an off-exchange principal trade with real-time and opening-session modes. SBI証券, マネックス証券, 松井証券, GMOクリック証券: no official individual Japanese-stock order API found in this screen (not exhaustively verified). GMOクリック moves to passkey-only login from 2026-11-28, part of an industry-wide passkey trend that hurts unattended logins.

capital.min_unit: Stocks: 100 shares per order (unified 2018-10-01), so the minimum position equals 100 times the share price. ETFs: usually 1 or 10 units (e.g., 1321 Nikkei 225 = 1口, 1306 TOPIX = 10口, 1570 leveraged = 1口, 1357 double-inverse = 1口, 1343 REIT index = 10口). J-REITs: 1 unit. Odd lots exist only as broker off-exchange services (S株, かぶミニ, プチ株, ワン株, ひと株), and none can be ordered through an API: kabuステーションAPI officially no; moomoo ひと株 app-only as documented; 立花 odd lots sell-only. Investment-unit distribution of all 3,695 TSE domestic companies at 2026-09-30: under JPY 50k: 592 (16.0%); under 100k: 1,275 (34.5%); under 200k: 2,313 (62.6%); under 300k: 2,923 (79.1%); under 500k: 3,432 (92.9%). Prime: 187 of 1,543 (12.1%) cost JPY 500k or more per unit; Prime median unit JPY 242,800 (mean 340,974) at 2026-08-31. The shares of Prime and TOPIX500 names under JPY 100k and 200k are not published. Estimate: under 100k roughly 15-25% and under 200k roughly 40-45% of Prime (low confidence); TOPIX500 likely skews higher-priced than Prime overall (unknown).
capital.sensible_book: Cross-sectional (the main Kronos use): at least 10 long positions of roughly equal JPY size, each within plus or minus 50% of target and at least 1 unit, drawn only from names whose unit cost is at or below the target size, preferably TOPIX500 members (finer ticks, spreads of 1-5 ticks). A short leg is possible only via 信用 with at least JPY 300k collateral. Single-instrument fallback: one 1- or 10-unit ETF, sized so that a stop- or volatility-based loss is at most 1-2% of capital per trade.
capital.capital_needed_jpy: About JPY 3,000,000 for a 10-15-name long-only book that stays mostly inside TOPIX500 (positions JPY 200-300k). About JPY 1,000,000 is the floor for a 10-name book restricted to share prices of JPY 1,000 or less. Add at least JPY 300k collateral plus a margin account for a long/short book (realistically JPY 3M or more). JPY 500k suffices only for single-ETF trading.
capital.at_500k: Not feasible for a cross-sectional book. Ten positions of JPY 50k require units of JPY 50k or less: 592 companies (16% of all listed), mostly low-priced non-TOPIX500 names on the coarse tick table, where a 1-yen tick is 20-33 bps at share prices of JPY 300-500, so round trips cost 40-100+ bps. Margin leverage (3.3x) could raise exposure but adds 2.8-2.94%/yr interest and maintenance-margin risk; not recommended. Feasible: single-ETF strategies (1-/10-unit ETFs cost well below JPY 500k per unit; exact current unit prices deliberately not checked because of the seal) with 1-2% risk per trade.
capital.at_1m: Marginal. Ten positions of about JPY 100k mean units of JPY 100k or less: 1,275 companies (34.5% of all listed), a minority of Prime, skewed to low-priced stocks. Costs are acceptable only for TOPIX500 members in that subset, whose count is unknown (compute from J-Quants). Long-only. Shorting would add margin requirements (JPY 300k collateral) and concentration.
capital.at_3m: Feasible. 10-20 positions of JPY 150-300k: units of JPY 300k or less cover 79.1% of all listed companies and an estimated 55-65% of Prime (median unit JPY 242,800), excluding the 12% of Prime at JPY 500k or more. TOPIX500-heavy long-only book possible; a long/short version via 制度信用 possible (94.6% of Prime are 貸借銘柄) but needs margin-account approval. Commission is 0 at zero-commission brokers; turnover cost is dominated by spread.

costs.round_trip_bps: TOPIX500 names at a zero-commission broker (三菱UFJ eスマート証券 via SOR, moomoo): about 5-15 bps (half-spread about 1-6 bps per side plus about 1-3 bps slippage for 100-share orders); about 2-8 bps if executed in the opening or closing auction. Low-priced non-TOPIX500 names: about 30-100+ bps. Add commissions where charged: IBKR fixed 16 bps per side at JPY 50k and 8 bps at JPY 100k or more (so +16-32 bps round trip); 立花 個別 plan about 15 bps per side at 50k, 7.7 at 100k, 6.2 at 300k (margin trades 0; the daily flat plan is about 5 bps of turnover at JPY 0.5-1M/day); Webull about 10-11 bps per side at 50-100k, about 9 bps at 300k.
costs.breakdown: Commission: 0 at 三菱UFJ eスマート証券 (cash, margin and プチ株, SOR required) and moomoo (cash). 立花: cash per-order or daily flat tables, margin 0. Webull: JPY 55-275 per order. IBKR: 0.08% with a JPY 80 minimum (or tiered 0.05% with a JPY 80 minimum plus exchange/clearing fees). Spread: tick tables. TOPIX500 (TOPIX100 + Mid400) ticks: up to JPY 1,000 price 0.1; up to 3,000: 0.5; up to 10,000: 1; up to 30,000: 5. Other stocks: up to 3,000: 1; up to 5,000: 5; up to 30,000: 10. That is 1.2-3.3 bps per tick for TOPIX500 names priced JPY 300-8,000, versus 4-33 bps per tick for other names priced 300-8,000. Measured spread-to-tick ratios (TSE, June 2025): TOPIX100 52% of names under 1.5 ticks; Mid400 80.7% within 1.5-5 ticks and 11.1% above 5; TOPIX Small 16.4% above 5; Standard 45.3% above 5; Growth 45.2% above 5. Average nominal TOPIX500 spread about JPY 2.3-2.5. Impact: negligible for 100-share orders in TOPIX500. Regime change: from 2027-03-01 tick tables are assigned per stock by STR (liquidity), not TOPIX500 membership, so backtest cost assumptions must be re-derived for live trading after that date. Tax: 20.315% on net gains (特定口座 with withholding available at domestic brokers, not at IBKR).
costs.holding_costs: Cash (現物) longs: no financing cost; dividends taxed at 20.315%. Margin longs: interest 2.80%/yr (三菱UFJ eスマート証券 制度) or 2.94%/yr (立花 from 2026-10-19; it was 2.50%), about 13-14 bps per 12 trading days. Plus 名義書換料 JPY 55 per unit at record dates, and 三菱UFJ eスマート証券 事務管理費 (11 sen/share/month, JPY 110-1,100) after 1 month. Margin shorts: 貸株料 1.10% (三菱UFJ eスマート証券) or 1.15% (立花) per year, about 5 bps per 12 trading days. Plus 逆日歩 (daily stock-borrow fee set by 日本証券金融 when shares are scarce; can spike around record dates), plus 配当落調整額. 一般信用 shorts at 三菱UFJ eスマート証券 add a system-set premium fee capped at 1% of price per day. IBKR borrow fees are variable. ETFs: expense ratios about 0.05-0.17% for index ETFs, 0.88% for leveraged/inverse (1570, 1357). No swap or roll costs for cash equities. デイトレ信用 at 三菱UFJ eスマート証券 is free if closed the same day.

research.shorting:
Available only through 信用取引 (margin): at 三菱UFJ eスマート証券 (制度信用, 一般信用 long-term, デイトレ), 立花証券 e支店 (制度信用; 一般信用 short availability unverified) and IBKR証券 (IBSJ stock-borrow margin). Not available at moomoo証券 or ウィブル証券 (no Japanese margin).

Requirements: margin-account approval (income/assets and experience; criteria not numerically published); at least JPY 300k collateral; initial margin at least 30% (33% at 立花 and IBSJ; 60% for leveraged/inverse ETFs); maintenance about 20-30% depending on broker (立花 loss-cut at 15%; IBSJ liquidates in real time with no margin call).

Shortable universe: 制度信用 shorts only in 貸借銘柄. At end-2025 that was 94.6% of Prime (1,514/1,599), 40.0% of Standard, 24.1% of Growth (2,290 total), plus 359 ETFs and 49 REITs. 一般信用 shorts cover broker-chosen names, limited inventory.

Costs: 貸株料 1.10-1.15%/yr, plus 逆日歩 (variable, spikes when shares are scarce), plus dividend adjustments; 一般信用 short premium up to 1% of price per day (三菱UFJ eスマート証券).

Restrictions: 制度信用 positions last at most 6 months. Price (uptick) restriction applies from a 10% or greater fall versus the base price until the next day's close; individual margin shorts of 50 units or fewer are exempt, but IBSJ does not apply that exemption. Short positions of 0.2% or more of shares outstanding must be reported. Exchange and 日本証券金融 measures (増担保, 貸株申込停止) can block new shorts. Short sales must be flagged.

Alternative: inverse ETFs (e.g., 1357 Nikkei double-inverse, 1-unit, 0.88% fee) give short exposure without margin, at the cost of leverage decay.

data_sources.name: J-Quants API V2 (JPX総研), the official retail data API
data_sources.coverage: All TSE-listed issues: domestic stocks, ETFs, ETNs, REITs, TSE-listed foreign stocks (not regional-only listings or PTS). Daily OHLCV plus turnover value (Va), raw and adjusted with AdjFactor; stop-high/low flags. Listing master with 17/33 sector codes, market segment, and 規模コード (TOPIX Core30, Large70, Mid400, Small), which allows point-in-time TOPIX500 membership. Also financial summaries and calendar. Light and above add TOPIX and investor-type flows; Standard and above add margin balances, short-sale ratios and reports, and the 日々公表 list; Premium adds AM/PM session bars, dividends and BS/PL/CF. Add-on: 1-minute bars and ticks. Data are only in-session (立会内) trades, in JPY.
data_sources.point_in_time_delisted: Universe: yes. /equities/master takes a date and returns the issues listed on that date, and delisted names are retrievable for dates when they were listed. Their bars are included within the plan's retention window. Not provided: delisting dates or a delisted list (use JPX's delisted list), corporate-action history, historical trading-unit data. Adjusted prices are recomputed retroactively, so point-in-time work needs raw prices plus factors. Adjustment covers splits, consolidations and rights issues only, not dividends. Corrections overwrite without history. No-trade days are returned as Null rows.
data_sources.history: Data start 2008-05-07. Free: 2 years ending 12 weeks ago (about 2024-08 to 2026-08), which lies entirely inside the sealed 2024-07 to 2026-10 window, so it is unusable before unsealing. Light: 5 years (from about 2021-11). Standard: 10 years (from about 2016-11). Premium: 20 years, effectively everything from 2008-05. Minute/tick add-on: last 2 years only (also inside the seal). Daily bars are published about 16:30 JST the same day.

research.hours_gaps_limits:
TSE cash sessions (JST): morning 9:00-11:30, afternoon 12:30-15:30. The close moved from 15:00 to 15:30 on 2024-11-05. Orders are accepted from 8:00 and 12:05. Continuous trading ends at 15:25, followed by a closing auction to 15:30. From 2027-10-12 the close becomes random within 15:29:30-15:30:00.

Closed on Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays and Dec 31 to Jan 3. The overnight gap is 17.5 h (15:30 to 9:00) and the weekend gap about 65.5 h. The open is set by auction and reflects US-session and OSE night-futures moves.

Daily price limits are set per stock from the base price (usually the previous close), for example:
- under JPY 500: ±80 yen
- 700-1,000: ±150
- 1,000-1,500: ±300
- 2,000-3,000: ±500
- 3,000-5,000: ±700
- 5,000-7,000: ±1,000
That is roughly 14-30% for typical price levels. Limit-locked days use pro-rata allocation (ストップ配分). Limits widen after two consecutive locked days with no trade; for ETFs, after one locked close.

Special quotes (特別気配) pause matching when the next trade would exceed the update range. No market-wide trading halt for cash equities was found in the TSE rule pages (medium confidence); OSE derivatives do have circuit breakers. Individual issues can be halted for disclosures.

PTS venues (e.g., Japannext) run extra sessions with thin liquidity; not needed for a daily strategy. J-Quants daily bars are available about 16:30 JST, so signals can be computed in the evening and opening-auction orders (寄成, or OPG at IBKR) submitted before 9:00. A process must be running about 8:00-9:00 JST on trading days. With kabuステーションAPI a human login is also needed after the roughly 6:00-6:30 forced logout.
research.kronos_fit:
In pretraining: yes. The Kronos corpus includes Japan Exchange Group stocks and ETFs (4,467 assets, 5-minute to weekly bars, about 281M observations, start date 2020-01-31) and a Japan stock-index set. Pretraining data run to June 2024, and Japan (XJPX) was an in-distribution evaluation exchange.

Consequence: Japanese data from 2020-01 to 2024-06 is in-sample for Kronos. Clean history exists only before 2020 (needs J-Quants Standard from about 2016-11, or Premium/DataCube from 2008) and after 2024-06 (the sealed test window, then live). The budget-fitting J-Quants Light plan has no clean period before the seal.

Breadth: 3,695 domestic companies, TOPIX500, about 420 ETFs and about 58 REITs. Breadth is limited by the capital and unit size, not by the universe.

Realistic bar frequency: daily. J-Quants daily OHLCV plus turnover maps directly onto Kronos's open/high/low/close/volume/amount inputs, costs JPY 1,650/month and is published about 16:30 JST. Intraday is not realistic: the minute add-on costs JPY 5,500/month and covers only 2 years, all inside the seal; kabuステーションAPI real-time data is capped at 50 symbols; 立花 discourages polling; and stored broker data is prohibited.

Best use:
1. Cross-sectional ranking of a price-filtered Prime/TOPIX500 universe on daily bars (lookback 40-512, horizon 5-12 days as in the paper's daily setting), rebalanced every 1-2 weeks to limit turnover and executed in the opening auction. Viable at about JPY 3M (marginal at 1M).
2. Kronos volatility forecasts for position sizing and risk caps (complements 1).
3. Single-ETF direction (1321, 1306, 1570) only as the JPY 500k fallback: breadth 1, weak given IC of about 0.02.

Kronos-small CPU inference for about 500 names per day looks plausible on the 14 GB laptop (not measured).
research.breadth:
Listed: 3,695 TSE domestic companies at 2026-09-30 (Prime 1,543, Standard 1,559, Growth 593). TOPIX500 (TOPIX100 + Mid400) is the liquid core with finer ticks. About 420 ETFs, many in 1- or 10-unit lots, and about 58 J-REITs in 1-unit lots.

Shortable via 制度信用 (end-2025): 2,290 issues, including 94.6% of Prime, plus 359 ETFs and 49 REITs.

Affordable breadth for 10 roughly equal positions:
- JPY 500k (units of JPY 50k or less): 592 companies (16%), mostly non-TOPIX500 low-priced names.
- JPY 1M (units of JPY 100k or less): 1,275 (34.5%).
- JPY 3M (units of JPY 300k or less): 2,923 (79.1%); for Prime more than 50% (median unit JPY 242,800 at 2026-08-31; 12.1% of Prime cost JPY 500k or more).

TOPIX500-specific affordable counts are unknown; they can be computed from the J-Quants listing master (ScaleCat) and the latest close after subscribing.

Kronos pretraining covered 4,467 Japanese stocks and ETFs, so nearly the whole universe was seen in pretraining (2020-01 to 2024-06).
research.edge_plausibility:
Low to moderate.

Literature:
- Japan is the well-known exception with no cross-sectional price-momentum premium (Fama and French 2012; Asness 2011).
- Short-horizon contrarian (reversal) profits have historically been significant on the TSE, strongest around 1 month (e.g., Chou, Wei and Chung 2007).
- Deep nets show some monthly cross-sectional skill in Japan using fundamental and market factors (Abe and Nakayama 2018).
A price-only model like Kronos will mostly capture reversal and volatility structure, which is widely known and traded.

Market structure: in 2023, foreign investors were 69.4% of TSE Prime brokerage share volume, individuals 22.7% and domestic institutions 7.3%, so retail is sizable and a plausible source of short-term overreaction. Colocated HFT accounts for about 75% of orders and about 35% of trading value (FSA, 2025), so intraday or very-short-horizon edges are unrealistic for a retail trader; multi-day horizons are less crowded.

Costs favour Japan relative to many markets: zero commissions at several API brokers, and TOPIX100 spreads often under 1.5 ticks (2-3 bps per tick). So IC of about 0.02 is not automatically eliminated by costs for TOPIX500 names at 1-2-week turnover. But the 100-share unit forces a concentrated 10-20-name book at JPY 3M or less, and idiosyncratic noise will dominate. Illustrative: IR ≈ IC × √breadth ≈ 0.02 × √(10 names × 21 rebalances) ≈ 0.3 before costs, and lower after costs and the transfer-coefficient loss from 100-share lumps.

Treat this as a research test of the pre-registered hypothesis, not an expected income source. This assessment does not use any 2024-07 to 2026-10 results.
risks: Capital granularity: 100-share units and no API-orderable odd-lot service. At JPY 500k the book must be about 5 names or move into low-priced non-TOPIX500 names where a 1-yen tick costs 20-33 bps, so cost and selection bias would dominate.

Pretraining contamination: Kronos saw Japanese stocks and ETFs from 2020-01-31 to 2024-06, so any backtest in that span overstates skill. The budget plan (J-Quants Light, 5 years) contains no clean period before the seal; clean pre-2020 data needs Standard (JPY 3,300) or Premium (JPY 16,500) or DataCube purchases.

Data licence: J-Quants requires deleting stored raw data after cancellation or downgrade, so buying Premium for one month only allows keeping non-reconstructable results. Broker APIs (kabuステーション, 立花) forbid accumulating their market data.

Login automation: kabuステーション needs a manual (soon passkey-only) login every trading day and after network drops, on Windows only. IB Gateway needs a weekly manual second-factor login. The industry is moving to passkey-only logins (GMOクリック from 2026-11-28; 三菱UFJ eスマート証券 target end-October 2026).

Vendor churn: 立花 e支店 API broke compatibility repeatedly (v4r7 to v4r10 in 2025-2026), has undisclosed throttling and can suspend heavy users. The moomoo and Webull Japanese-stock APIs are new and changing; moomoo's Japanese quote rights are listed as Unsupported.

Forward testing: no broker except IBKR offers a market-realistic paper environment for Japanese stocks (kabu returns fixed values; 立花 demo fills market orders at JPY 100; moomoo has no Japanese paper trading). Forward tests must be self-simulated against real quotes or auction prices, or run live at minimum size.

Rule changes during or after the study: per-stock STR-based tick tables from 2027-03-01, random closing auction from 2027-10-12, and a TSE working group (from October 2026) considering lowering trading units. Backtest cost and fill models may not carry over.

Shorting frictions: margin approval and at least JPY 300k collateral; 逆日歩 spikes and 一般信用 premium fees up to 1%/day; 6-month 制度信用 limit; uptick rule after a 10% drop (IBSJ has no 50-unit exemption); 増担保/貸株申込停止 measures; no Japanese shorting at moomoo or Webull.
Rising financing costs: 立花 raised margin buy interest from 2.50% to 2.94% from 2026-10-19; margin-financed longs cost about 13-14 bps per 12 trading days.
Gap and limit risk: 17.5 h overnight and about 65.5 h weekend gaps; stop-high/low locks with pro-rata allocation can make exits impossible; opening-auction gaps.
Concentration: 10-20 names with uneven 100-share lumps; realized performance dominated by idiosyncratic noise given IC of about 0.02.
Tax and admin: 20.315% on gains. IBKR has no 特定口座, so the user must file a return. Stock losses generally cannot offset crypto 雑所得 (general rule; not verified in this screen).
Microstructure competition: about 35% of trading value is HFT and about 69% of brokerage volume is foreign, so short-horizon price-only signals are likely crowded.

Approve J-Quants Standard (JPY 3,300/month, from about 2016-11) or a one-off Premium month (JPY 16,500, from 2008-05) to get pre-2020 history that Kronos has not seen? Note the deletion-on-downgrade licence term.

立花証券 e支店 API (立花証券 第110号) is free, covers Japanese stocks cash and margin, provides real-time quotes and board plus about 20 years of daily bars, and is OS-agnostic (Linux and Python explicitly supported). It uses HTTPS JSON (Shift-JIS) plus an EVENT I/F over WebSocket or HTTP chunked transfer.

立花 API authentication and versions: public-key auth from v4r9 (2026-05-30). From 2026-06-27 only v4r9 remained, with no API phone-number authentication. v4r10 was released 2026-08-29 and v4r9 retired 2026-09-27. Enabling the API requires a passkey web login.

立花 API flow limit is 10 requests/s, described as a design cap the broker cannot serve for everyone. Heavy polling 8:00-15:30 is discouraged and accounts may be suspended. Provided information may not be accumulated, edited or processed. A second PIN is required in each order.
立花 demo environment uses non-real prices; market orders fill at a flat JPY 100 and limit orders at the limit; no 15:30 extension or closing auction. Not usable for a realistic forward test.

立花 fees, tax included. Cash per-order: up to JPY 100k 77, 200k 99, 500k 187, 1M 341. Daily flat: up to 120k/day free, 200k 176, 500k 253, 1M 506. Margin commission 0. 買方金利 2.94% (from 2026-10-19 trades; was 2.50%); 貸株料 1.15%.

IBSJ: one paper account (DU...) per live account; no 特定口座 (self-filing). Order types include OPG, MOC, LOC. IB Gateway is available for Linux x86_64 and ARM64.

moomoo証券: Japanese stocks and ETFs have JPY 0 commission and ひと株 has JPY 0 commission. Japanese-stock margin trading is not offered.

ウィブル証券 (Webull JP, 第48号) OpenAPI trades Japanese stocks and ETFs (MARKET and LIMIT only) over REST, MQTT and gRPC with Python/Java SDKs. Japanese cash commission JPY 55 (up to 50k), 99 (up to 100k), 115 (up to 200k), 275 (up to 1M). No Japanese margin.

Japanese margin trading: initial margin at least 30% of contract value with a minimum of JPY 300k; 制度信用 positions last at most 6 months; 一般信用 terms are set by the broker; leveraged/inverse ETFs need 60%.
貸借銘柄 (shortable under 制度信用) at end-2025: Prime 1,514 of 1,599 (94.6%), Standard 628 (40.0%), Growth 148 (24.1%), total 2,290 (60.5%); also ETFs 359 and REITs 49.

Short-sale price restriction triggers after a 10% or greater fall from the base price and lasts until the next day's close. Individual margin shorts of 50 units or fewer are exempt. Short positions of 0.2% or more of shares outstanding must be reported.

TSE hours: 9:00-11:30 and 12:30-15:30 JST (since 2024-11-05); orders accepted from 8:00 and 12:05; closing auction 15:25-15:30. A random close (15:29:30-15:30:00) starts 2027-10-12. Closed on weekends, holidays and Dec 31 to Jan 3.
Daily price limits by base price, e.g., ±80 yen under 500, ±150 for 700-1,000, ±300 for 1,000-1,500, ±500 for 2,000-3,000, ±700 for 3,000-5,000; limits widen after consecutive locked days.

Tick sizes: TOPIX500 constituents (and ETFs with 10-unit lots) use 0.1 yen up to 1,000, 0.5 up to 3,000, 1 up to 10,000. Other stocks use 1 yen up to 3,000, 5 up to 5,000, 10 up to 30,000. From 2027-03-01 tick tables are assigned per stock by STR (liquidity).

Spread-to-tick ratio (June 2025): TOPIX100 52.0% of names under 1.5 ticks; Mid400 80.7% within 1.5-5 and 11.1% above 5; TOPIX Small 16.4% above 5; Standard 45.3% above 5; Growth 45.2% above 5. Average TOPIX500 nominal spread about JPY 2.3-2.5 (read from a chart).

J-Quants plans, tax included: Free JPY 0 (2 years ending 12 weeks ago; 5 calls/min); Light 1,650 (5 years; 60/min); Standard 3,300 (10 years; 120/min); Premium 16,500 (20 years, data from 2008-05-07; 500/min). Minute/tick add-on 5,500/month (2 years). V2 since 2025-12-22; V1 ended 2026-06-01.

J-Quants: the listing master by date gives a point-in-time universe including delisted names; bars of delisted names are included within retention. No delisting dates or corporate-action history. Adjusted prices are recomputed retroactively (use raw prices plus factors); adjustments cover splits, consolidations and rights only; on-exchange trades only; JPY.

J-Quants licence: individuals' private use only; no redistribution or institutional/academic research. On cancellation or downgrade, stored data and reconstructable derivatives must be deleted; non-reconstructable results may be kept.

Kronos pretraining included Japan Exchange Group stocks and ETFs: 4,467 assets, 5-minute to weekly bars, about 280.6M observations, listed start date 2020-01-31. Pretraining data extend to June 2024; Japan (XJPX) is an in-distribution evaluation exchange.

Derived from JPEQ-29 and JPEQ-32: J-Quants Light's span before the seal (about 2021-11 to 2024-06) lies entirely inside Kronos's Japanese pretraining period, so a JPY 3,000/month budget gives no clean validation history. Pre-2020 data needs Standard (from about 2016-11) or Premium (from 2008-05).

2023 TSE Prime brokerage share volume: foreign investors 69.4%, individuals 22.7%, domestic institutions 7.3%, securities companies 0.6% (51 trading participants).
Colocated HFT accounts for about 75% of order count and about 35% of trading value on Japanese exchanges.

Literature: no momentum premium in Japan (Fama-French 2012; Asness 2011). Contrarian/reversal profits on the TSE, strongest at about 1 month (Chou, Wei and Chung 2007). Deep-learning monthly cross-sectional forecasts in Japan (Abe and Nakayama 2018).
Listed-share capital gains are taxed at 20% (15% national + 5% local) plus the reconstruction surtax (2.1% of income tax), 20.315% in total. IBSJ offers no 特定口座.

IB Gateway restarts automatically each day but requires a manual second-factor login weekly. The official IBKR page could not be fetched directly, so this rests on search summaries of it.

TSE set up a working group on further small-investment measures (2026-07-28; first meeting 2026-10-01). Options studied previously include lowering the exchange trading unit (odd-lot trading on exchange); no decision has been made.

research.summary:
Feasible on cost and operations at JPY 1M or more, and only marginal at JPY 500k. The workable contract is the Nikkei 225 micro: 10 x index, JPY 5 tick (JPY 50 per tick), JPY 11 per side at domestic brokers, and about JPY 41-45k exchange (JSCC VaR) margin per contract as of 2026-11-06. A taker round trip costs about 1.3-3.2 bp of notional. Nikkei micro and mini both trade 8:45-15:45 and 17:00-6:00 JST, plus holiday sessions. 2025 average daily volume was 548k contracts for micro and 731k for mini.

Capital:
- JPY 500k supports only 1 micro (on/off sizing). A 1.5-sigma stop is about 1.6-2.6% of capital, and a limit-size gap of 8% is about 6-9%.
- JPY 1M (1-2 micro) is the practical minimum.
- JPY 3M allows sizing in steps (3-6 micro) or a mini-TOPIX/NT (Nikkei/TOPIX ratio) pair. The mini contract only fits a 1-2% risk rule from about JPY 7-10M.

API routes:
- kabuステーションAPI (三菱UFJ eスマート証券, formerly auカブコム) is the cheapest. Drawbacks: needs Windows 11, a manual login every day, and has no paper environment (its test port returns fixed values). Its terms forbid continuous storage of API data or feeding it to external AI.
- IBKR証券 works on Linux through IB Gateway and has a paper account. Fees are about JPY 14-15 per micro side, plus JPY 200/month for OSE data. A manual 2FA login is needed weekly.
- 立花証券 e支店 API does not support futures orders (stocks only, as of v4r10, 2026-09-27).
- 楽天 offers only an Excel/Windows RSS add-in.

Data:
- J-Quants has futures OHLC only on Premium (JPY 16,500/month), which is over budget.
- JPX's J-Quants DataCube sells per-contract daily (JPY 110), 1-minute (JPY 220) and tick (JPY 330) files per product-month. These include expired contracts and night sessions. A useful history costs a one-off JPY 15-50k, which needs approval.
- IBKR keeps expired-futures history only for 2 years, so pre-July-2024 contracts cannot be retrieved there.

Kronos:
- No OSE futures were in pretraining; its only futures were Chinese. Nine Japanese stock indices and 4,467 JPX stocks/ETFs (2020-01 to 2024-06, 5-minute to weekly) were included.
- Effective breadth is 1-2, so cross-sectional ranking is impossible. Best fits are daily single-instrument direction or volatility forecasts for sizing.
- At IC about 0.02, expected IR is about 0.1-0.3. Trading costs are not the binding constraint; signal strength and breadth are, and a weeks-long forward test can only validate execution, not edge.

- mini JPY 413,116 / 451,566

capital.capital_needed_jpy: About JPY 1M for a minimal sensible micro book (1-2 size steps). About JPY 3M for volatility-scaled sizing (3-6 micro) or a mini-TOPIX vs about 5-6 micro NT pair. At least JPY 7-10M before a mini (x100) fits the 1-2% rule.
capital.at_500k: Marginal. Only 1 micro, so sizing is on/off. Margin of about JPY 45k is about 9% of capital, and notional leverage is about 0.8-1.1x. One daily sigma is about 1.0-1.8% of capital, and a 1.5-sigma stop about 1.6-2.6%, at or slightly above the 1-2% rule. A limit-size 8% gap (night, weekend or holiday) is about 6-9% of capital. No mini-TOPIX, no NT pair, no mini.
capital.at_1m: Feasible: 1-2 micro. One micro risks about 0.5-0.9% of capital per daily sigma and 0.8-1.3% per 1.5-sigma stop; two micro risk about 1.6-2.6% per stop. Margin is about 4.5-9% of capital. Volatility scaling is coarse (0, 1 or 2 contracts).
capital.at_3m: Comfortable: 1-6 micro, giving useful volatility-targeting granularity (3-4 micro is about 1.1-1.8% risk per stop). 1 mini-TOPIX (about 1.1-1.5% of capital per daily sigma) is possible, which makes an NT pair against about 5-6 micro feasible. A mini (one daily sigma about 1.6-2.9% of capital) is still too coarse.

costs.round_trip_bps:
Taker on both sides, 1 lot, as a share of notional:
- Nikkei 225 micro: about 1.3-3.2 bp
- Nikkei 225 mini: about 1.1-2.7 bp
- mini-TOPIX: about 1.1-2.3 bp
- TSE Growth 250: about 12-51 bp (prohibitive for active trading)

Passive limit orders on both sides cost commission only: about 0.4-0.7 bp for micro, ignoring adverse selection and non-fills.
costs.breakdown:
Micro at eSmart (IBKR Fixed in brackets):
- Commission: JPY 11 x 2 = JPY 22 (JPY 28) per round trip, which is 0.4-0.55 bp (0.5-0.7 bp) on JPY 400-550k notional.
- Spread crossing: 1-2 ticks = JPY 50-100 = 0.9-2.5 bp. The micro's typical quoted spread is not published. Market-maker obligations cap it at 4 ticks (JPY 20 per unit, at least 50 contracts) in the nearest quarterly month and 6 ticks in the nearest monthly month. For mini, JPX research on 2025 measured an average relative spread of about 1.44 bp (about 1 tick) and about 65 contracts at the best quotes.
- Slippage: a 1-5 lot order should fill at the touch in normal conditions; it is wider around news, the opening and closing auctions, and the night session (unmeasured).

Mini: commission JPY 77 per round trip (0.14-0.19 bp) plus a 1-tick spread of JPY 500 (0.9-1.25 bp).

mini-TOPIX: commission JPY 83.6 per round trip (about 0.3 bp) plus 1-2 ticks of 0.25 pt (JPY 250-500, 0.8-2.0 bp).

Growth 250: commission JPY 83.6 plus 1-3 ticks of 1 pt (JPY 1,000-3,000 on JPY 0.6-0.9M notional, 11-50 bp). Its market-maker maximum spread is 8 ticks, day session only.

IBKR Tiered adds pass-through exchange and clearing fees (exact OSE micro fee unknown) and possibly JPY 10 per contract held overnight.
costs.holding_costs:
- Explicit: no margin interest, no borrow fee, no swap points.
- Implicit: the futures basis embeds (JPY short rate minus dividend yield), so a long future earns roughly total return minus the short rate. Japanese dividends cluster at March and September ends, which shifts calendar spreads.
- Margin cash: probably earns no interest (unverified).
- Rolls: each roll is about one extra round trip, i.e. micro 1.3-3.2 bp. That is about 5-13 bp/yr rolling quarterly, or about 16-38 bp/yr if rolling monthly micro serial contracts. The micro and mini specs allow calendar-spread strategy orders, but kabuステーションAPI has no spread order type.
- Expiry: holding to the SQ (final settlement) settles at the SQ price, computed from constituents' opening prices on the 2nd Friday. The last trading day is the business day before. Commissions apply to SQ settlement at eSmart.

research.shorting:
Yes, symmetric. A short (新規売) is opened exactly like a long. Index futures are cash-settled, so there is no stock borrow and no borrow fee, and shorts make no dividend payments (dividends are priced into the basis).

Under the VaR method, short margin is slightly lower than long margin: micro Dec-2026 short JPY 41,312 vs long JPY 45,157 (2026-11-06).

Restrictions:
- broker position limits (eSmart: 200 large-equivalent contracts per side; micro counts 0.01);
- eSmart's 両建 rule for simultaneous long and short in the same contract: the required margin is the larger of half the margin on the two-sided position or the normal VaR margin;
- OSE emergency powers (narrower limits, higher margin, position limits).

No short-specific price rule (like the cash-equity uptick rule) was found in the OSE index-futures outline or in eSmart's F&O rules (medium confidence).
