research.hours_gaps_limits: Regular session 9:30-16:00 ET. In JST that is 23:30-06:00 while the US is on standard time (2026-11-01 to 2027-03-14) and 22:30-05:00 during US DST (2026: Mar 8 to Nov 1; by rule 2027: Mar 14 to Nov 7). Extended hours: e.g., Webull pre-market 18:00-23:30 JST, after-hours 06:00-10:00 and an overnight session 10:00-18:00 for about 1,500 names. IBSJ runs an overnight venue 20:00-03:50 ET (about 10:00-17:50 JST in winter), DAY limit orders only, no fractions. Gaps: a 17.5-hour overnight gap every weekday (06:00 to 23:30 JST) and a Friday-close to Monday-open weekend gap of about 65.5 hours. NYSE holidays: 2026-11-26 and 2026-12-25; 13:00 ET (03:00 JST) early closes on 2026-11-27 and 2026-12-24; the 2027 list is on NYSE. No daily price limit applies to individual stocks. LULD bands (5%, 10%, 20%, or the lesser of USD 0.15 or 75%, by price and tier; Tier 1 = S&P 500, Russell 1000 and select ETPs) widen near the open and close. If price stays outside a band for 15 s, trading pauses for 5 minutes. Market-wide circuit breakers on the S&P 500: -7% and -13% halt trading for 15 minutes if hit before 15:25 ET; -20% halts it for the rest of the day. The Rule 201 short-sale price test applies after a 10% drop. Settlement is T+1 (since 2024-05-28). For the operator: run the daily model after the 06:00 JST close, then queue orders for the next US open or close. IBSJ supports OPG/MOC/LOC; Webull and moomoo take DAY/GTC limit or market orders, held server-side. No overnight watching is needed. However, the gateway (IB Gateway or OpenD) or the API token must be valid when orders are sent, fills and rejects arrive at JST night.
research.kronos_fit: Pretraining: yes, heavily. The Kronos paper's data table lists Nasdaq (8,725 assets, about 2.48B observations, from 2000-01-01, 1-minute to weekly bars) and NYSE (7,073 assets, about 2.13B observations, from 2000-01-01). Together that is about 38% of the roughly 12B records, and the pretraining data run to June 2024. Two consequences. (1) Any US evaluation before July 2024 is in-sample, so pre-2024-07 backtests or validation are contaminated by memorisation risk; model or hyper-parameter selection needs post-June-2024 data (inside the sealed window) or the forward test. (2) There is no domain shift: US equities are in-distribution. It is unknown whether delisted names were included in pretraining. Breadth: a daily cross-section of 500-1,000 liquid names (S&P 500 / Russell 1000). Frequency: daily bars (lookback 40-512, horizon 1-12), rebalanced daily (only at Webull or IBSJ cost levels) or weekly. Intraday is unrealistic: survivorship-free intraday data costs USD 29-79/mo or more, turnover multiplies costs, and the session falls in the JST night. Best use: cross-sectional ranking (top-k long, optional long-short from about JPY 1M). Secondary use: volatility forecasts for position sizing, against strong HAR/GARCH baselines. Single-instrument direction on SPY/QQQ has breadth of about 1, and IC of about 0.02 is not enough there. CPU-only inference for about 500 names/day on the laptop seems plausible (estimate, not measured).
research.breadth: Tradable universe: about 6,265 US stocks/ETFs at Webull (about 3,000 fractional); 5,900+ US/Canadian stocks at Saxo; 1,000+ margin-eligible names at moomoo; all US-listed names at IBSJ (margin list after login). Historical research universe: Sharadar has 21,000 stock tickers including delisted ones. Practical universe at JPY 0.5-3M: S&P 500 (about 500) or Russell 1000 (about 1,000) names, all LULD Tier 1 with about 3 bps effective spreads. Small caps add names, but spread and borrow costs rise steeply. Nominal breadth is 500-1,000 bets per rebalance; effective breadth is much lower because of sector and factor correlation.
research.edge_plausibility: Low prior. US large caps are the most competitive equity market. Estimates in the SEC's 2010 concept release put HFT above 50% of volume. Bloomberg Intelligence estimates retail at about 17-24% of volume (2021-2025). The SEC said in 2022 that over 90% of retail marketable orders are internalised by wholesalers. Published cross-sectional predictors decay: returns are 26% lower out of sample and 58% lower after publication (McLean-Pontiff 2016). 65% of 452 anomalies fail at |t| of 1.96 or more (Hou-Xue-Zhang 2020). Few strategies with more than 50% one-sided monthly turnover survive costs (Novy-Marx-Velikov 2016). Daily ML stat-arb on the S&P 500 earned over 0.45%/day before costs in 1992-2015, with declining profits in recent years (Krauss-Do-Huck 2017). Back-of-envelope (my assumptions, not sourced): with IC 0.02, cross-sectional daily volatility of 1.5-2% and a top-decile mean z of about 1.75, a top-decile long book earns about 5-7 bps/day gross over the universe. Daily turnover of 50-100% then costs about 2-9 bps/day at Webull-level round trips (4-9 bps), leaving at best a thin positive margin. The same turnover costs 15-60 bps/day at moomoo, IBSJ-Fixed or Saxo levels, which is clearly negative. The IC must also hold when trading at the next open (the overnight gap is lost) or at the close; this is unverified. Weekly rebalancing cuts costs but needs a 5-day-horizon IC.
risks: Kronos pretraining contamination: US data up to June 2024 were in pretraining, so no clean US validation period exists before the sealed window; validation must be carved out of 2024-07 onward or come from the forward test

The edge is weak relative to costs. An IC of about 0.02 survives only at near-zero commission (Webull) or IBSJ Tiered at about JPY 3M. moomoo, IBSJ-Fixed and Saxo cost levels erase it at daily turnover.
Broker-term volatility: Webull changed core terms three times in 2026 (API margin, zero commission, options API). 'Permanent' zero commission and moomoo's free FX ('may become paid') can change.

Passkey mandate (July 2026 at IBSJ, 2026-10-31 at moomoo) may force manual re-authentication of IB Gateway or OpenD (IBC 3.24.0 added passkey support; unattended re-login is unverified). IBSJ allows only one brokerage session per username.
IBSJ US margin/shorting is not yet fully released, and the eligible-name list is visible only after login
Webull has no private API paper environment, so the forward test must be small-live or simulated in-house. Webull execution venue and quality are undisclosed in the sources reviewed.

Tax and admin: IBSJ is 一般口座 only. Gains must be recomputed on the moving-average basis at TTM, and statements use FIFO. Stock losses cannot offset crypto 雑所得, and CFD shorts (Saxo/IBSJ) fall in a separate 先物 pool.
FX: a JPY-funded USD book carries USD/JPY risk that is not cheaply hedged at JPY 500k. Conversion costs recur if settling in JPY.
Data licence: Sharadar must be deleted within 30 days of cancelling, so keep the subscription for the study's life. Broker or free data are survivorship-biased.
Concentration: a 10-name book is exposed to overnight earnings gaps of the size LULD does not cover overnight, and shorts face Rule 201 restrictions, recalls and borrow-fee spikes
Operational: orders go out at JST night, and the laptop must be up when orders are sent.

Blinding disclosure: two incidental exposures occurred during this research. (1) A text search of the Kronos paper (arXiv 2508.02739) for 'XNAS' displayed fragments of the paper's own forecasting-IC tables (test period from July 2024). (2) An IBSJ marketing page showed example share prices dated 2025-11-11. Neither was used or reported here; the orchestrator may want to log this.

title: Japan tax treatment across the candidate markets vs crypto

research.topic: Japan tax treatment of trading gains for a salaried Japan resident: JP listed stocks/ETFs, OSE futures/options, retail OTC FX, US stocks via a JP broker, and crypto, with the 20万円 rule and a worked JPY 1,000,000 example. Phase 0 feasibility input, as of 2026-11-08.
research.summary: Gains from JP or US listed stocks/ETFs (上場株式等), OSE futures/options and registered OTC FX are all taxed separately at 20.315%. Only listed stocks can be held in a 特定口座 源泉徴収あり, which withholds tax at each sale and needs no return. Futures, options and FX always need a 確定申告 once total non-salary income exceeds JPY 200,000. The separately taxed groups do not offset each other: listed stocks and dividends are one group, and futures/options/FX/CFD/commodity futures are another. Each group carries losses forward 3 years, but only if a return is filed every year. Crypto is currently 雑所得 in 総合課税, taxed at progressive rates up to about 55.945%. Its losses cannot be offset against other income or carried forward. A 20.315% separate regime for 特定暗号資産 (crypto names on the FSA register, traded through registered dealers) is enacted in Act No. 12 of 2026, with a 3-year carry-forward. It starts on 1 January of the year after the crypto parts of the FIEA amendment (Act No. 64, promulgated 2026-07-23) take effect, which must happen by 2027-07-22. No cabinet order fixing that date was found, and e-Gov shows 2028-01-01 for the tax provisions, so the expected start is 2028-01-01. The 20万円 rule only removes the income-tax filing duty: resident-tax filing is still needed, and anyone who files a return must include that income. Worked example (salary JPY 6,000,000, tax year 2027): 特定口座 源泉あり nets JPY 796,850 from a JPY 1,000,000 gain. Declared separately taxed income nets JPY 759,073 because of a temporary 2026–2027 basic-deduction cliff. Crypto under 総合課税 nets JPY 710,094. US dividends net JPY 717,165 without the foreign tax credit and about JPY 740,772 with it.
research.findings_md:
# Japan tax on trading gains for a salaried resident (Phase 0 feasibility input)

As of 2026-11-08. This is general information, not tax advice. All pages were fetched on 2026-11-08. NTA タックスアンサー pages carry the stamp "[令和8年4月1日現在法令等]", meaning law as at 2026-04-01. No market, performance or backtest data was used. Local copies of every source are in `<scratch>/phase0/` (nta_*.txt, mof_*.txt, law_r8_12.txt, sangiin_fiea.txt, egov_*.json). The arithmetic is in `<scratch>/scripts/calc.py`.

## 1. Summary by regime

Glossary for the table:
- **Stock bucket**: 上場株式等, i.e. listed stocks, ETFs, J-REITs, foreign-listed stocks, public funds and specified bonds.
- **Futures bucket**: 先物取引に係る雑所得等, i.e. exchange futures/options, commodity futures, and OTC FX/CFD with registered dealers.
- **20万 test**: the JPY 200,000 threshold for non-salary income explained in section 2.2.

| Regime | Rate (income tax + resident tax) | Nets (損益通算) with | Loss carry-forward | 確定申告 needed? | Interaction with the 20万円 rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **(a) JP listed stocks/ETFs, 特定口座 源泉徴収あり** | 20.315% withheld at each sale (15.315% + 5%) | Stock bucket only, plus declared listed dividends/interest (申告分離) | 3 years, only if declared; file the loss year and every later year | No (申告不要, chosen per account). Yes if you want to net across brokers or carry losses forward | Excluded from the 20万 test and from 合計所得金額 when 申告不要 is chosen |
| **(a) 一般口座 / 特定口座 源泉徴収なし** | 20.315% via the return | Same as above | Same as above | Yes if total non-salary 所得 > JPY 200,000, or if filing for any reason | Counts toward the test. If ≤ JPY 200,000: no income-tax return, but a resident-tax return is still due (5%) |
| **(b) OSE futures/options** | 20.315% (申告分離), no withholding | Futures bucket only (FX, CFD, commodity futures, くりっく365/株365) | 3 years; loss-year return with 付表 plus continuous filing | Yes (above JPY 200,000 or when filing) | Counts |
| **(c) Retail OTC FX (registered dealer)** | Same as (b) | Same as (b) | Same as (b) | Same as (b) | Counts |
| **(d) US stocks via a JP broker: sale gains** | 20.315% in Japan; no US tax on capital gains | Stock bucket (nets with JP stocks) | 3 years | As (a), depending on account type | As (a) |
| **(d) US dividends** | US 10% at source (treaty), then JP 20.315% on the net amount. Foreign tax credit only via a return | If 申告分離 is chosen: nets with stock-bucket losses | Excess foreign tax: 3-year carry-forward | Not required; required to claim the foreign tax credit | Undeclared (申告不要) dividends are excluded |
| **(e) Crypto, now** | 総合課税: 5–45% income tax × 1.021 + 10% resident tax (max ≈ 55.945%) | Only inside 雑所得; never against salary or the separate buckets | None while it is 雑所得 | Yes if total non-salary 所得 > JPY 200,000 | Counts |
| **(e) Crypto after the reform (expected from 2028-01-01)** | 20% separate (15% income tax + 5% resident tax), plus surtax = 20.315% | Own bucket. 特定暗号資産 derivatives move into the futures bucket | 3 years within the crypto bucket | Probably yes: the enacted outline contains no withholding account | Unknown, probably counts |

## 2. Rules that apply to every regime

### 2.1 Rates and the 2027 surtax change
- The income-tax brackets run from 5% to 45% across seven bands ([NTA 2260](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/2260.htm)).
- Resident-tax 所得割 is a flat 10% (4% prefecture + 6% municipality) ([総務省](https://www.soumu.go.jp/main_sosiki/jichi_zeisei/czaisei/czaisei_seido/150790_06.html)).
- The separate-taxation rate is 15% income tax + 5% resident tax, plus the surtax ([NTA 1463](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1463.htm), [NTA 1522](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1522.htm)).
- **Recent change:** the 令和8年度 (2026) reform restructures the surtax from 2027. 復興特別所得税 (reconstruction surtax) falls to 1.1% and a new 1% 防衛特別所得税 (defence surtax) is added. The combined rate is unchanged, so 20.315% stays 20.315%. The reconstruction surtax now runs through 令和29年 (2047) ([NTA 2260 ※3](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/2260.htm), [NTA 1476](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1476.htm), [NTA 1331](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1331.htm)).

### 2.2 The JPY 200,000 rule for salaried employees
- **Who it covers:** an employee paid by one employer, with all salary withheld and 年末調整 (year-end adjustment) done, and salary ≤ JPY 20,000,000.
- **The rule:** such an employee need not file a 確定申告 if total non-salary 所得 is ≤ JPY 200,000 ([NTA 1900](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1900.htm)).
- **What is left out of the total:** only items for which 申告不要 is allowed and chosen. That means 源泉徴収口座 stock gains, listed dividends and specified-bond interest. 一般口座 stock gains, futures/FX and crypto all count.
- **Filing for another reason:** if a return is filed anyway (e.g. a medical-expense refund), the ≤ JPY 200,000 income must be included ([NTA 1900 Q&A](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1900_qa.htm)).
- **Resident tax has no 20万 exemption.** A municipal resident-tax return (住民税申告) is still required ([名古屋市, updated 2026-01-13](https://www.city.nagoya.jp/kurashi/zeikin/1035069/1012012/1012022/1033974/1012026.html); [横浜市, updated 2026-04-01](https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kurashi/koseki-zei-hoken/zeikin/y-shizei/kojin-shiminzei-kenminzei/kojin-shiminzei-shosai/shiminzei-shinkoku.html)). Filing a 確定申告 counts as the resident-tax filing, and the deadline is March 15 (Yokohama).
- **Effect in practice:** a small gain (≤ JPY 200,000 total) in 一般口座, futures, FX or crypto escapes income tax and pays only resident tax (5% for separately taxed income, 10% for crypto). The same gain in a 源泉徴収あり account has 20.315% withheld.
- **Inference:** a net loss in one separate bucket cannot reduce another bucket's income ([NTA 2250 注5](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/2250.htm), [NTA 1522](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1522.htm)). So it should not lower the 20万 total either.

### 2.3 合計所得金額 (total income) and the temporary 2026–2027 basic-deduction cliff
- **What 合計所得金額 includes:** declared 上場株式等 gains, 先物取引に係る雑所得等 (futures/FX), and listed dividends under 申告分離, all measured before carry-forwards.
- **What it excludes:** 源泉徴収口座 gains and dividends for which 申告不要 was chosen ([NTA 質疑応答 "合計所得金額2,000万円の判定"](https://www.nta.go.jp/law/shitsugi/shotoku/06/38.htm); [NTA 1331 table](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1331.htm)).
- **Income-tax basic deduction (基礎控除) for 令和8・9年分 (2026 and 2027):** JPY 1,040,000 if 合計所得 ≤ 4.89M; JPY 670,000 if 4.89M–6.55M; JPY 620,000 if 6.55M–23.5M ([NTA 1199](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1199.htm); [2026 outline (大綱) p.1–3](https://www.mof.go.jp/tax_policy/tax_reform/outline/fy2026/20251226taikou.pdf)).
- **From 2028:** JPY 990,000 if ≤ 1.32M, then JPY 620,000 up to 23.5M. This is subject to a review every 2 years from 2028 (inflation indexation).
- **The cliff:** declaring separately taxed income can push 合計所得 over 4.89M and cut the deduction by JPY 370,000. That raises the income tax on salary.
  - For a JPY 6M salary, 給与所得 (salary income after the employment deduction) is 4.36M. Declared non-salary income above JPY 530,000 triggers the cliff.
  - Salaries above about JPY 6.66M are already past the threshold.
  - 源泉徴収あり + 申告不要 gains never trigger it.
- **Resident tax:** the resident-tax basic deduction stays at JPY 430,000 (合計所得 ≤ 24M), so there is no cliff there. The 2026 outline's local-tax part changes only the employment-deduction minimum ([大綱 p.4](https://www.mof.go.jp/tax_policy/tax_reform/outline/fy2026/20251226taikou.pdf); [大阪市 R9 page](https://www.city.osaka.lg.jp/zaisei/page/0000678587.html) lists it as "改正なし（最高43万円）").

## 3. Detail by regime

### (a) Listed Japanese stocks and ETFs
- **What counts:** 上場株式等 include exchange-listed shares, ETFs, J-REITs and "外国金融商品市場において売買されている株式等" (shares traded on foreign markets). Gains are 申告分離 at 15% + 5%, plus the 2.1% surtax ([NTA 1463](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1463.htm)).
- **特定口座 (special account) basics:** one per broker. The broker computes the gains. With 源泉徴収 chosen, it withholds 15.315% + 5% at each sale. The choice must be made before the year's first sale and cannot be changed mid-year ([NTA 1476](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1476.htm)).
  - Gains can be left undeclared (申告不要), choosing per account.
  - Dividends received into the account are netted against that account's losses automatically.
  - If you declare the account's losses, you must also declare its dividends.
  - Netting across brokers, or carrying a loss forward, requires a 確定申告.
  - NTA 1476 refers to "差金決済に係る差益", so margin (信用取引) closing trades are withheld the same way and stay in the stock bucket. Medium-high confidence.
- **Account choice in practice:**
  - 源泉あり withholds at each sale, which ties up some trading capital within the year. Tax is refunded inside the account if later losses arrive in the same year.
  - 一般口座 / 源泉なし pay the tax with the return the following spring. In exchange they must file above JPY 200,000, and the gains then enter 合計所得 (the section 2.3 cliff).
- **Netting:** only with 上場株式等 dividends/interest declared under 申告分離, and specified bonds (特定公社債). Not with 一般株式等 (unlisted shares), the futures bucket, crypto or salary ([NTA 1474](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1474.htm), [NTA 2250 注5](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/2250.htm)). NISA losses can be neither netted nor carried forward (NTA 1474 注3).
- **Carry-forward:** 3 years. You must file the loss year with the 付表 and then file "連続して" (continuously) every year, including years with no sales (NTA 1474).

### (b) OSE futures and options, and (c) retail OTC FX
- **Scope of the futures bucket:** NTA 1522 lists:
  - exchange 市場デリバティブ: 有価証券/指数先物, 有価証券オプション, futures/index futures/options under the FIEA;
  - commodity futures/options;
  - OTC derivatives with a 第一種金融商品取引業者 or 登録金融機関, excluding "一定の暗号資産または金融指標に係るもの";
  - covered warrants.
  Contracts that settle by physical delivery (受渡し) are excluded.
- **Rate:** 15% + 5% separate, plus surtax ([NTA 1522](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1522.htm)).
- **FX:** exchange FX (くりっく365) and OTC FX with a registered counterparty belong to this bucket. FX "not 市場 or 店頭デリバティブ" (e.g. an unregistered counterparty) is 総合課税 雑所得 and cannot be netted with the bucket ([NTA 1521](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1521.htm)).
- **Losses:** they net only inside the bucket. Carry-forward is 3 years. You must file the loss year with the 付表（先物取引に係る繰越損失用） and the 計算明細書, then file continuously ([NTA 1523](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1523.htm)).
- **No withholding or 特定口座:** 特定口座 covers 上場株式等 only (NTA 1476). Gains are reported through the 確定申告 with the 計算明細書 (NTA 1522), and they count toward the 20万 test.
- **Overseas-exchange futures** (e.g. CME via a Japanese broker) fall outside the separate regime and are 総合課税 雑所得. Sources: [楽天証券 tax page](https://www.rakuten-sec.co.jp/web/support/tax/details/foreign-exchange/), consistent with the NTA 1522 definitions. Medium confidence.
- **Pending:** stocks and derivatives still cannot be netted. The FSA's 令和9年度 (FY2027) request asks to extend netting to デリバティブ取引・預貯金等 ([FSA, Aug 2026](https://www.fsa.go.jp/news/r8/sonota/fsa_trps_r9.pdf)). The decision is due in the December 2026 outline.
- **Design consequence:** a long-stocks / short-index-futures hedge splits its P&L across two buckets that cannot offset each other. Gains in one are taxed in that year while losses in the other only carry forward within their own bucket.

### (d) US stocks bought through a Japanese broker
- **Category:** stocks traded on foreign markets are 上場株式等 (NTA 1463 ⑥). So: 20.315%, eligible for a 特定口座 (broker support varies), and nettable with JP stocks.
- **FX movement:** the yen gain includes the currency move over the holding period. It is not split out as 雑所得 ([NTA 質疑応答](https://www.nta.go.jp/law/shitsugi/shotoku/02/02.htm)).
- **USD cash, by analogy:** using held foreign currency to buy a foreign-currency asset realises the FX gain on that cash as separate income (NTA case for 外貨預金 → MMF, [質疑応答 02/43](https://www.nta.go.jp/law/shitsugi/shotoku/02/43.htm)). A strategy that recycles USD balances may create such items. Medium confidence; confirm.
- **No US tax on sale gains:** US-source capital gains are generally not taxable for a nonresident alien present in the US fewer than 183 days ([IRS, reviewed 2026-07-23](https://www.irs.gov/individuals/international-taxpayers/federal-income-tax-withholding-and-reporting-on-other-kinds-of-us-source-income-paid-to-nonresident-aliens)).
- **Dividends:**
  - The US withholds 10% (Japan-US treaty, portfolio dividends) ([MOF 日米租税条約のポイント](https://www.mof.go.jp/tax_policy/summary/international/tax_convention/press_release/sy151107_index.htm)). The rate may differ for issuers not incorporated in the US.
  - Japan then withholds 15.315% + 5% on the after-US-tax amount. 申告不要 is allowed. The dividend tax credit (配当控除) does not apply to foreign dividends ([Monex FAQ, updated 2023-05-23](https://faq.monex.co.jp/faq/show/2583?site_domain=default); [NTA 1331 ※1](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1331.htm)).
- **Foreign tax credit (外国税額控除):**
  - It needs a 確定申告 that declares the dividends under 総合課税 or 申告分離課税 ([楽天証券](https://www.rakuten-sec.co.jp/web/support/tax/details/deducting/)), with the 明細書 attached.
  - Income-tax limit = income tax × (foreign income ÷ total income). There is a separate surtax limit. The resident-tax limit is 30% of the income-tax limit. Unused limits and excess foreign tax carry forward 3 years.
  - Not available for NISA ([NTA 1240](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1240.htm)).
  - Declaring the dividends brings them into 合計所得 (and into the section 2.3 cliff).

### (e) Crypto
**Now (all of 2026 and 2027):**
- **Category:** in principle 雑所得（その他雑所得）, taxed in 総合課税 at progressive rates. FAQ 2-2 (updated Dec 2025) adds that if the year's crypto 収入金額 (gross receipts) exceeds JPY 3M, it is 事業所得 in principle when books (帳簿書類) are kept, and 業務に係る雑所得 when they are not. 事業所得 is judged case by case, e.g. on 営利性 ([NTA crypto FAQ, 令和7年12月改訂, law as of 2025-12-01](https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/pdf/virtual_currency_faq_03.pdf)).
- **Losses:** 雑所得 losses cannot be set against salary or other income (FAQ 2-11; [NTA 2250 注2](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/2250.htm)). They cannot be carried forward either; the 3-year carry-forward of 純損失 (net loss) applies to 事業所得 and similar losses of 青色申告 (blue-return) filers ([NTA 2070](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/2070.htm)).
- **Crypto margin/derivatives** are expressly excluded from the futures regime and are 総合課税 (FAQ 2-12).
- **Netting:** crypto cannot be netted with the separately taxed FX/futures bucket (NTA 1521).
- **20万 test:** crypto counts toward it ([NTA 1906](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1906.htm)).

**Planned separate taxation: enacted, start date tied to the FIEA amendment.**
- **Policy decision:** the 令和8年度 tax outline (cabinet decision 2025-12-26) lists these measures "金融商品取引法等の改正を前提に" ([大綱 p.22–23](https://www.mof.go.jp/tax_policy/tax_reform/outline/fy2026/20251226taikou.pdf)):
  - 特定暗号資産 (crypto whose name is on the 金融商品取引業者登録簿) transferred to or through a 暗号資産取引業 dealer: separate taxation at 20% (15% income tax + 5% resident tax);
  - 3-year carry-forward within that bucket;
  - 特定暗号資産 derivatives added to the futures bucket (so they could net with FX and OSE futures);
  - crypto funds (投資信託) brought into the 一般株式等 rules;
  - dealers must report customer trades to the tax office by January 31 of the following year;
  - other crypto becomes 総合課税 譲渡所得 with no JPY 500,000 special deduction, no long-term halving and no loss offset.
- **Legislation:** these are enacted in 所得税法等の一部を改正する法律, 令和8年法律第12号, passed and promulgated 2026-03-31 ([MOF](https://www.mof.go.jp/about_mof/bills/221diet/index.html); [enacted text](https://www.sangiin.go.jp/japanese/joho1/kousei/gian/221/pdf/s0802210032210.pdf)): new 措置法 38条の2 and 38条の3, and an amendment to 41条の14.
- **Start date mechanics:**
  - 附則1条10号: the provisions take effect "次号に掲げる規定の施行の日の属する年の翌年の一月一日". 第11号 is the enforcement date of the FIEA amendment. 附則39条: they apply to transfers on or after that date.
  - The FIEA amendment (金融商品取引法及び資金決済に関する法律の一部を改正する法律, 令和8年法律第64号) passed 2026-07-15 and was promulgated 2026-07-23. Its crypto parts take effect on a date set by cabinet order within one year of promulgation, i.e. by 2027-07-22 ([参議院 bill page](https://www.sangiin.go.jp/japanese/joho1/kousei/gian/221/meisai/m221080221057.htm)).
  - The only implementing cabinet order found (FSA, 2026-07-29) brought into force just the 20-day items, effective 2026-08-12 ([FSA](https://www.fsa.go.jp/news/r8/shouken/20260729/20260729.html)).
  - e-Gov data (updated 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-29) still shows a 2027-07-22 placeholder for the FIEA and 2028-01-01 for the tax provisions ([e-Gov API, 租特](https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/2/law_revisions/332AC0000000026); [e-Gov API, 金商法](https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/2/law_revisions/323AC0000000025)).
- **Expected start: 2028-01-01.** Any 2027 FIEA enforcement date gives 2028-01-01. Only a 2026 date would give 2027-01-01, which would need a cabinet order within weeks; none was found. Daiwa Institute of Research also expects 2028 ([DIR, 2026-02-06](https://www.dir.co.jp/report/research/law-research/tax/20260206_025575.html)).
- **Still unknown:** whether any withholding or 申告不要 account will exist for crypto. None appears in the enacted outline (要綱).

## 4. Netting matrix (can losses in the row offset gains in the column?)

| | Listed stocks / US stocks / ETFs | Listed dividends (申告分離) | Futures/options/FX/CFD | Crypto now (雑所得) | 特定暗号資産 (from about 2028) | Salary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Listed stocks | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Futures/FX bucket | No | No | Yes | No | No (特定暗号資産 derivatives will be inside this bucket) | No |
| Crypto now (雑所得) | No | No | No | Yes, within 雑所得 (also overseas futures and other 雑所得) | n/a | No (unless classed 事業所得) |
| 特定暗号資産 bucket | No | No | No | n/a | Yes | No |

The 特定暗号資産 row and column come from the 大綱 and law text plus the DIR summary. Medium-high confidence.

## 5. Worked example: the same JPY 1,000,000 gain, salary JPY 6,000,000

**Assumptions:**
- Tax year 2027 (令和9年分), with resident tax for 令和10年度. One employer, 年末調整 done.
- 給与所得控除 (employment deduction) JPY 1,640,000, so 給与所得 = JPY 4,360,000 ([NTA 1410](https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/shotoku/1410.htm)).
- Social-insurance deduction JPY 900,000 (assumed, about 15% of salary). Single, no other deductions.
- The JPY 1,000,000 is the year's only non-salary income: net of fees, no carried-forward losses.
- Income-tax basic deduction per section 2.3. Resident-tax basic deduction JPY 430,000. 調整控除 JPY 2,500 in every case, so it cancels out.
- 均等割 (per-capita resident tax) and 100-yen rounding are ignored. Surtax 2.1%.
- Baseline tax on salary alone: income tax + surtax JPY 147,534; resident-tax 所得割 JPY 300,500.

| Regime | Extra income tax + surtax | Extra resident tax | US tax | Total tax on the JPY 1M | After tax | Effective rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A. 特定口座 源泉あり, 申告不要 (JP stocks/ETFs; US stock sale gains) | 153,150 | 50,000 | 0 | **203,150** | **796,850** | 20.32% |
| B. Declared separate income: 一般口座 / 源泉なし, OSE futures/options, OTC FX | 190,927 (= 153,150 + 37,777 from the deduction falling JPY 1.04M → 0.67M) | 50,000 | 0 | **240,927** | **759,073** | 24.09% |
| E. Crypto, 雑所得 総合課税 (taxable income 2.42M → 3.79M, crossing from the 10% to the 20% band) | 189,906 | 100,000 | 0 | **289,906** | **710,094** | 28.99% |
| D1. US dividends of JPY 1M gross, 特定口座, 申告不要 | 137,835 | 45,000 | 100,000 | **282,835** | **717,165** | 28.28% |
| D2. US dividends declared under 申告分離 + foreign tax credit | +127,782 net of credit | +31,446 net of credit | 100,000 | **≈259,228** | **≈740,772** | 25.92% |

**D2 credit detail:** income-tax credit 61,847, surtax credit 1,298, resident-tax credit 18,554. The uncredited JPY 18,301 can be carried forward 3 years. The dividends are declared at the gross amount.

**2028+ under current law** (basic deduction flat at JPY 620,000, so no cliff; values may still be indexed):
- A: 796,850.
- B: 796,850.
- 特定暗号資産 under the new regime: 796,850.
- Crypto still in 総合課税 (non-特定): 742,766 (25.72%).
- D1: 717,165.
- D2: ≈779,780.

**Not modelled:** crypto classed as 事業所得 with a 青色申告 deduction of up to JPY 650,000. Classification is case by case.

**Small-gain case (JPY 150,000, no other non-salary income):**
- 源泉あり: JPY 30,472 withheld.
- 一般口座, futures or FX: no income-tax return; resident tax 5% = JPY 7,500.
- Crypto: resident tax 10% = JPY 15,000.
- This advantage disappears if a return is filed for any reason. Scale check: JPY 200,000 is a 40% annual return on JPY 0.5M, 20% on JPY 1M, and 6.7% on JPY 3M.

## 6. Recent or pending changes to watch
1. Surtax restructure from 2027-01-01: 1.1% + 1%, total unchanged; 復興 period extended to 2047.
2. 2026–2027 basic deduction of JPY 1.04M / 0.67M with a cliff at 合計所得 4.89M. From 2028 the schedule is 0.99M / 0.62M with a review every 2 years from 2028.
3. Crypto separate taxation is enacted, expected 2028-01-01, pending the FIEA cabinet order.
4. Crypto FAQ 2-2 (Dec 2025): the JPY 3M gross-receipts test for 事業所得 / 業務雑所得.
5. The FSA FY2027 request to net derivatives with stocks; the December 2026 outline will decide.
6. The 令和9年度 outline (expected around December 2026) may change any of the above.

## 7. What this means for the Phase 0 screen (tax side only)
- For a JP or US stock/ETF strategy, a 特定口座 源泉徴収あり gives the least friction: a flat 20.315%, no return, and no effect on 合計所得. Margin shorts stay in the same bucket.
- OSE futures/options and OTC FX also pay 20.315%, but always need self-filing. They cannot offset stock P&L. In 2026–2027 they can trigger the basic-deduction cliff (in the example, an extra 3.8 percentage points on the gain).
- Under current rules crypto is the worst for this profile, and its losses are lost. That is unchanged until about 2028.
- With JPY 0.5–3M of capital, the absolute tax differences are small next to costs and skill. The JPY 200,000 exemption only helps if other non-salary income does not already use it up.
conclusions: Listed JP and US stocks/ETFs, OSE futures/options, and OTC FX with a registered dealer are all taxed separately at 20.315% (15.315% income tax including surtax + 5% resident tax). The rate stays the same from 2027 when the surtax is split into 1.1% reconstruction + 1% defence.

Only listed stocks/ETFs (JP or US) can be held in a 特定口座 源泉徴収あり. There tax is withheld at each sale, no return is needed, and the gains stay out of 合計所得金額. Futures, options and FX always need a 確定申告 above the JPY 200,000 total.

The two separate groups never offset each other: listed stocks with listed dividends/interest and specified bonds are one, and futures/options/FX/CFD/commodity futures are the other. Each carries losses forward 3 years, but only if a return is filed for the loss year and every year after. So a stock-versus-futures hedge can be taxed on one leg while the other leg's losses sit unused.

The JPY 200,000 rule only removes the income-tax filing duty. Resident-tax filing is still needed, and any return filed must include the income. Undeclared 特定口座 源泉あり gains and dividends are excluded from the test. Crypto 雑所得 counts toward the same JPY 200,000.

In 2026–2027 the income-tax basic deduction drops from JPY 1,040,000 to 670,000 once 合計所得 exceeds JPY 4.89M. For a JPY 6M salary, declaring more than JPY 530,000 of separately taxed or crypto income costs an extra JPY 37,777. 源泉あり + 申告不要 stock gains avoid this.

Crypto is currently 雑所得 in 総合課税 (5–45% income tax × 1.021, plus 10% resident tax). Its losses cannot be offset against other income or carried forward, and crypto margin trading is 総合課税. Under the Dec 2025 NTA FAQ, gross receipts above JPY 3M with books make it 事業所得 in principle, decided case by case.

Separate 20.315% taxation of 特定暗号資産 is enacted (Act No. 12 of 2026, new 措置法 38条の2/38条の3, 41条の14 amendment), with a 3-year carry-forward. It also puts derivatives on 特定暗号資産 into the futures bucket. It starts on 1 January of the year after the FIEA amendment's crypto provisions take effect (Act No. 64, promulgated 2026-07-23, in force by 2027-07-22 by cabinet order). The expected start is 2028-01-01.

US dividends: 10% US withholding, then 20.315% Japanese tax on the net amount (28.28% combined). Recovering part of it through the foreign tax credit requires a return. US capital gains are taxed only in Japan.

Worked example, tax year 2027, salary JPY 6M, JPY 1M gain. After tax: 特定口座 源泉あり 796,850; declared separately taxed (一般口座 / futures / FX) 759,073; crypto 総合課税 710,094; US dividends without the credit 717,165 and with it about 740,772. In 2028+ the separately taxed cases rise to 796,850.

claims.claim: Gains on 上場株式等 (listed shares, ETFs, J-REITs, and shares traded on foreign markets) are 申告分離課税 at 15% income tax + 5% resident tax, plus the 2.1% surtax on the income tax: 20.315% in total.

From 2027 the 復興特別所得税 (reconstruction surtax) falls from 2.1% to 1.1% and a new 1% 防衛特別所得税 (defence surtax) is added. The combined rate is unchanged, so 20.315% stays 20.315%. The reconstruction surtax now runs through 令和29年 (2047).

A 特定口座 源泉徴収あり (one per broker) withholds 15.315% + 5% resident tax at each sale. The gains can be left undeclared (申告不要), choosing per account. The withholding election must be made before the year's first sale and cannot be changed mid-year.
Netting 源泉徴収口座 gains or losses with other accounts, or carrying losses forward, requires a 確定申告. Declaring an account's losses also requires declaring the dividends received into that account.

Listed-stock losses can be netted, via a return, with 上場株式等 dividends/interest declared under 申告分離. Any remaining loss carries forward 3 years. This requires filing the loss year with the 付表 and filing continuously every year after, including years with no sales.

Stock-bucket (株式等) losses cannot be offset against other income (e.g. futures, salary), and other income's losses cannot be offset against stock gains. Listed and unlisted (一般株式等) shares are also kept apart. NISA losses can be neither netted nor carried forward.

An employee paid by one employer with full withholding and year-end adjustment, and salary of JPY 20M or less, must file only if non-salary 所得 totals more than JPY 200,000. The total leaves out 源泉徴収口座 stock gains, listed dividends and specified-bond interest for which 申告不要 is chosen. Everything else counts, including 一般口座 gains, futures/FX and crypto.
If a return is filed anyway (e.g. for a medical-expense refund), non-salary income of JPY 200,000 or less must still be included.

Resident tax has no JPY 200,000 exemption: an employee with non-salary income of JPY 200,000 or less must still file a municipal resident-tax return (deadline March 15). Filing a 確定申告 counts as that return.
合計所得金額 includes declared 上場株式等 gains, 先物取引に係る雑所得等 and listed dividends under 申告分離, measured before carry-forwards. It excludes 源泉徴収口座 gains and dividends for which 申告不要 was chosen.

From 2028: JPY 990,000 if JPY 1.32M or less, then JPY 620,000 up to JPY 23.5M. From 2028 it is to be reviewed every 2 years.

checks.correction: Resident-tax 基礎控除 stays ¥430k for 令和9年度 (no change in the outline). The local-tax changes are: 給与所得控除 minimum ¥650k→¥690k (+¥50k for 令和9・10年度); dependant and 勤労学生 income limits; ひとり親控除 ¥300k→¥330k; adjustments to the 住宅借入金 credit and ふるさと納税 特例控除. The local-tax section raises the 給与所得控除 minimum to JPY 690,000 (+50,000 for 令和9・10年度) and also lifts the spouse/dependent income limit to 62万, the ひとり親 child limit to 62万 and the 勤労学生 limit to 89万. The resident-tax basic deduction is unchanged at 43万.

claims.claim: For 2026 and 2027, the 給与所得控除 (employment deduction) on salary of JPY 3.6M–6.6M is 20% of salary + JPY 440,000. So a JPY 6M salary gives a JPY 1,640,000 deduction and 給与所得 of JPY 4,360,000.

The income-tax brackets (速算表) are 5%, 10% (from JPY 1.95M), 20% (from 3.3M), 23% (6.95M), 33% (9M), 40% (18M) and 45% (40M and above). Resident-tax 所得割 is a flat 10% (4% prefecture + 6% municipality).

The futures bucket (先物取引に係る雑所得等, 15% income tax + 5% resident tax, separate) covers: exchange 市場デリバティブ (index/securities futures and options, including 有価証券オプション); commodity futures/options; OTC derivatives with a 第一種金融商品取引業者 or 登録金融機関, excluding certain crypto ones; and covered warrants. Contracts settled by physical delivery are excluded.
Futures-bucket losses net only within the bucket and carry forward 3 years. This requires filing the loss year with the 付表（先物取引に係る繰越損失用） and the 計算明細書, then filing continuously.

FX that is a 市場デリバティブ or an OTC derivative with a 第一種金融商品取引業者 or 登録金融機関 belongs to the futures bucket. Other FX (e.g. an unregistered counterparty) is 総合課税 雑所得 and cannot be netted with the futures bucket.
特定口座 covers only 上場株式等, so futures/options/FX gains are not withheld. They are reported through the 確定申告 with a 計算明細書 and count toward the JPY 200,000 test.
Overseas-exchange futures (外国市場デリバティブ) traded via a Japanese broker are 総合課税 雑所得, not part of the separate futures bucket.
As of August 2026, derivatives cannot be netted with listed stocks. The FSA's FY2027 tax request asks to extend netting to デリバティブ取引・預貯金等; the decision is pending in the December 2026 outline.
US-listed shares bought through a Japanese broker are 上場株式等 (traded on a foreign market). They are taxed at 20.315%, may be held in a 特定口座, and net with Japanese listed shares.
On a foreign-stock sale, the yen gain includes the exchange-rate movement over the holding period. It is not split out as 雑所得.

Using held foreign-currency deposits to buy a foreign-currency asset (an MMF in the NTA case) realises the FX gain on that currency as income. By analogy this may apply to reused USD cash in a brokerage account.
US-source capital gains are generally not taxable for a nonresident alien present in the US fewer than 183 days in the year.
Under the Japan-US tax treaty the US withholds 10% on portfolio dividends paid to Japan residents.

claims.claim: Japan withholds 15.315% + 5% on US dividends after the US tax is deducted. 申告不要 is allowed. The dividend tax credit (配当控除) does not apply to dividends from foreign companies.

The foreign tax credit requires a 確定申告 that declares the dividends under 総合課税 or 申告分離課税, with the 明細書 attached. Income-tax limit = income tax × (foreign income ÷ total income). There is a separate surtax limit. The local-tax limit is 30% of the income-tax limit. Excess foreign tax and unused limits carry forward 3 years. NISA dividends are excluded.

Crypto gains are in principle 雑所得（その他雑所得）, taxed in 総合課税. If the year's crypto gross receipts exceed JPY 3M, they are in principle 事業所得 when books are kept and 業務に係る雑所得 when they are not; 事業所得 is judged case by case.

claims.claim: Crypto 雑所得 counts toward the JPY 200,000 non-salary threshold for employees.

Act No. 12 of 2026 (所得税法等の一部を改正する法律, passed and promulgated 2026-03-31) enacts the crypto changes. Transfers of 特定暗号資産 (names on the 金融商品取引業者登録簿) to or through a 暗号資産取引業者 are taxed separately at 15% income tax, plus 5% resident tax per the outline. There is a 3-year carry-forward within that bucket (措置法 38条の2, 38条の3), and 特定暗号資産 derivatives join the futures bucket (41条の14).
The crypto tax provisions take effect on 1 January of the year after the FIEA amendment takes effect (附則1条10号 and 11号) and apply to transfers on or after that date (附則39条).

The FIEA amendment (金融商品取引法及び資金決済に関する法律の一部を改正する法律, Act No. 64 of 2026) passed 2026-07-15 and was promulgated 2026-07-23. Its crypto provisions take effect on a date set by cabinet order within one year of promulgation (by 2027-07-22). The FSA's July 2026 order brought into force only the 20-day items (effective 2026-08-12).

e-Gov records still show a 2027-07-22 placeholder for the FIEA crypto provisions and 2028-01-01 for the crypto tax provisions. The expected start of crypto separate taxation is therefore 2028-01-01; it would be 2027-01-01 only if the FIEA took effect in 2026, and no such cabinet order was found.

From the same start date, crypto outside the separate regime becomes 総合課税 譲渡所得 with no JPY 500,000 special deduction, no long-term halving and no loss offset. Crypto dealers must report customer trades to the tax office, starting with trades in the year after the start date.
claims.source: https://www.mof.go.jp/tax_policy/tax_reform/outline/fy2026/20251226taikou.pdf (pp.22-23) ; https://www.sangiin.go.jp/japanese/joho1/kousei/gian/221/pdf/s0802210032210.pdf (Art.1 amendments to 所得税法33条/69条; 附則39条2項)

checks.correction: These rules apply to crypto whose transfer produces 譲渡所得. Non-特定 crypto sold as part of a profit-seeking, continuous activity (所法33②一) stays 雑所得 or 事業所得. That income is still 総合課税, and 雑所得 losses are still not offsettable. Reporting confirmed: dealers report trades from the year after the start date.

Crypto outside the separate regime does not automatically become 譲渡所得. The changes (no 50万 deduction, no long-term halving, no loss offset) apply where the gain is 譲渡所得. Continuous for-profit trading can stay 雑所得 or 事業所得. The changes apply from the year after the FIEA amendment takes effect.

claims.claim: The top marginal rate on 総合課税 income such as crypto is about 55.945% (45% income tax × 1.021 + 10% resident tax).

Worked example: tax year 2027, salary JPY 6M, social insurance JPY 900k, single, JPY 1M gain. After tax: 特定口座 源泉あり + 申告不要 796,850; declared separately taxed (一般口座 / OSE futures and options / OTC FX) 759,073, including 37,777 from the basic-deduction cliff; crypto 総合課税 710,094; US dividends without the foreign tax credit 717,165, with it about 740,772. Under 2028+ law: separately taxed 796,850 and crypto 総合課税 742,766.
claims.source: <scratch>/scripts/calc.py (functions kiso at line 7, base at line 17; asserts at lines 45-46), using TAX-11, TAX-13, TAX-14, TAX-27 inputs

checks.correction: The numbers are right only for the stated profile. The cliff cost exists only when declared income lifts 合計所得 from ≤¥4.89M to above it in 2026–27. Crossing ¥6.55M costs ¥50k of deduction × the marginal rate × 1.021 instead. If 合計所得 is already above ¥6.55M (for example because of other declared income), declared separately taxed gains cost a flat 20.315% (net 796,850), the same as 特定口座. From 2028 there is no cliff above ¥1.32M. D2 (2027) treats the surtax as a single 2.1%; the credit's treatment of the 1% 防衛特別所得税 is unknown (a few hundred yen at most).

Under 2028+ law, crypto traded as 特定暗号資産 through registered dealers (spot or derivatives) is taxed separately at 20.315%, netting 796,850 in this example. The 742,766 line applies only to non-特定 crypto. The 37,777 cliff assumes no other 合計所得. If other income already puts 合計所得 above JPY 4.89M, the cliff costs a new declared strategy 0. Crossing JPY 6.55M costs about JPY 10,210 more.

claims.claim: Listed dividends can be taxed by 申告不要, 総合課税 or 申告分離課税. The choice made in the return cannot be changed later by an amended return or request for correction. 申告不要 dividends are not included in 合計所得金額.

new_findings.finding: The ¥200k filing test adds up all non-salary 所得: crypto 雑所得 plus any futures/FX/一般口座 gains. Once any return is filed, all of it must be declared. 源泉徴収口座 stock gains can still be left 申告不要 account by account even when the user files. Crypto 雑所得 also raises 合計所得, so it may already trigger the 2026–27 basic-deduction cliff, or a new strategy may trigger it.
new_findings.impact: If other non-salary income already exceeds ¥200k, a return is filed anyway. The 'no-filing / small gains untaxed' advantage then disappears for futures/FX, and 特定口座's main remaining edge is keeping gains out of 合計所得. The after-tax ranking in TAX-38 must be redone at the actual 合計所得; the cliff penalty may be zero or larger.

new_findings.finding: From the crypto start date (expected 2028-01-01), OTC derivatives on 特定暗号資産 dealt with a 第一種金融商品取引業者 move into the 先物取引に係る雑所得等 bucket (措法41条の14①二 as amended; outline item ④, applying to settlements on or after the start date). Spot 特定暗号資産 becomes its own third bucket (38条の2: losses 'deemed not to arise' for any other purpose), and it cannot net with stocks or futures. All of Act No.12's 特定暗号資産 provisions (38の2, 38の3, 41の14, 41の19, 附則39) were checked: none creates a 特定口座 or withholding route for crypto.
new_findings.impact: From 2028 crypto-derivative P&L can offset FX, OSE futures and CFD P&L and share their 3-year carry-forward. This is a portfolio-level tax link between crypto derivatives and an FX/futures strategy. The 20.315% vs 総合課税 gap that favours non-crypto markets lasts only for tax years 2026–2027 for registered-dealer crypto, and crypto will still always require a 確定申告.

new_findings.finding: NISA 成長投資枠 makes listed JP and foreign stocks and ETFs 0%-taxed. Limits: ¥2.4M of purchases per year, ¥18M lifetime of which ¥12M growth. A sale restores quota only the following year, at book value. NISA losses are ignored, foreign withholding on NISA dividends cannot be credited, and leveraged/derivative-type investment trusts and 整理・監理銘柄 are excluded. The FSA's FY2027 request seeks same-year restoration of the lifetime limit only; the annual cap would stay.
new_findings.impact: This is a real advantage only for stock/ETF candidates. At ¥500k capital with a ~12-day holding period (about 20 turnovers a year, so ~¥10M of purchases), only about a quarter of trades could fit inside NISA, and far fewer at ¥3M. It does not apply to futures, FX or crypto. It suits a low-turnover sleeve, not the main strategy.

new_findings.finding: The request to allow netting between derivatives and stocks is a perennial one. The MOF-hosted FY2024 FSA sheet is identical (▲¥8,240M), and the FY2027 sheet is ▲¥16,800M. The FY2026 outline answered only '総合的に検討する'.
new_findings.impact: The base case for 2027 should keep separate stock and futures buckets. Do not assume cross-bucket netting when sizing a mixed stock and futures plan.

new_findings.finding: Crypto losses are not always ring-fenced. Under FAQ 2-2, if a year's crypto gross receipts exceed ¥3M and books are kept, the income is in principle 事業所得 (case by case on profit motive). 事業所得 losses can be set against salary (NTA 2250), and 青色申告 filers can carry 純損失 forward 3 years (NTA 2070).
new_findings.impact: The crypto comparison point may be less unfavourable than 'no offset, no carry-forward' for crypto income that qualifies as 事業所得. The rates are still progressive and 総合課税 until 2028. Qualification is judged case by case.

new_findings.finding: Since 2023-01-01 the US withholds 10% of the gross amount realised when a foreign person sells an interest in a publicly traded partnership (IRC §1446(f); IRS page reviewed 2026-07-21). Some US-listed commodity ETPs are partnerships.
new_findings.impact: A US-ETF universe should exclude PTPs, because 10% of gross proceeds per sale is prohibitive for a short-horizon strategy. Whether Japanese brokers block PTP orders was not checked (unknown).

new_findings.finding: From the 附則1条10号 date (expected 2028-01-01), crypto derivatives on 特定暗号資産 move into the 先物取引に係る雑所得等 bucket. Act 12 Art.7 amends 措法41条の14①二 to exclude only non-特定 crypto, and 附則43条 applies this to settlements on or after that date. Spot 特定暗号資産 goes to its own separate bucket (38条の2/38条の3), which nets with neither stocks nor futures. Which coins count as 特定暗号資産 depends on a MOF ordinance not yet issued.
new_findings.impact: From 2028, P&L from crypto leverage or derivatives shares a bucket with OSE futures/options and registered OTC FX/CFDs. A new FX or futures strategy's losses could then offset those crypto gains, and vice versa, with a 3-year carry-forward. A stock strategy cannot do this. No netting is possible in 2027. Spot crypto nets with no candidate market. Secondary explainers such as Monex (Sept 2026) say crypto cannot be netted with FX; that is true only for spot.

new_findings.finding: The 5% resident-tax part of crypto separate taxation is already law. 地方税法等の一部を改正する法律 (Act No. 2 of 2026, promulgated 2026-03-31) sets prefecture 2% + municipality 3% (指定都市 1% + 4%) on 特定暗号資産 income. It takes effect on 1 January of the second year after the FIEA amendment takes effect; e-Gov's placeholder is 2029-01-01, i.e. resident tax on 2028 income.
new_findings.impact: 20.315% crypto parity from income year 2028 is fully legislated, not just 'per the outline'. Only the FIEA cabinet-order date remains open.

new_findings.finding: The new crypto regime has no withholding account and no 申告不要 option. 措法38条の2 provides self-assessed 15% plus annual dealer reports to the tax office, starting with trades in the year after the regime starts (附則39条2項). 38条の3's carry-forward requires a 明細書 in the loss year and continuous filing.
new_findings.impact: From 2028 crypto reaches rate parity with stocks and FX but not filing parity. A 特定口座 源泉あり stock/ETF strategy stays the only option that needs no return; FX/futures and crypto both need annual returns.

new_findings.finding: The 2026–2027 basic-deduction cliffs (JPY 1.04M falls to 0.67M above 合計所得 of JPY 4.89M, and to 0.62M above 6.55M) depend on total 合計所得. That total includes crypto 雑所得 as well as any declared separate income.
new_findings.impact: TAX-38's 37,777 cliff cost depends on the user's other income. If other income already puts 合計所得 above JPY 4.89M, a declared FX/futures/一般口座 strategy adds no cliff cost; crossing 6.55M adds about JPY 10,210. 特定口座 源泉あり + 申告不要 keeps stock gains out of 合計所得. From 2028 these cliffs disappear at this income level.

new_findings.finding: NTA crypto FAQ 2-2 (updated Dec 2025): if a year's crypto-trading revenue exceeds JPY 3M, the income is in principle 事業所得 when books are kept (judged case by case) and 業務に係る雑所得 when they are not.
new_findings.impact: The summary's blanket statement that crypto losses can be neither offset nor carried forward holds only for 雑所得. Bookkept crypto trading classed as 事業所得 can offset losses against salary (所得税法69条). With 青色申告 it can also carry net losses forward 3 years and claim the special deduction, which lowers the pre-2028 crypto tax baseline somewhat. This classification is not guaranteed.

new_findings.finding: The FY2027 reform is still pending; the ruling-party outline normally comes in mid-December 2026. The FSA's 2026-08-31 requests are: 損益通算 extended to derivatives and deposits via 特定口座 (requested before and deferred), same-year restoration of NISA's lifetime cap, and permanent exemption of interest on OTC-derivative margin. None asks to change the 3-year carry-forwards or the 20.315% rate, and searches found no FY2027 rate-rise proposal.
new_findings.impact: The split between the stock bucket and the FX/futures bucket could change. Re-check after the December 2026 outline before freezing tax assumptions in the pre-registration. Any netting extension would likely start years later because 特定口座 systems would have to change.

new_findings.finding: NISA gains are tax-free, but purchases are capped at JPY 3.6M a year (成長投資枠 2.4M + つみたて投資枠 1.2M for eligible funds only). Sold holdings free up lifetime room only the following year; the FY2027 request seeks same-year restoration of the 18M lifetime cap, and the annual cap would stay. NISA losses are ignored.
new_findings.impact: At JPY 500k capital a 0% wrapper covers only about 4.8 full capital turnovers a year (2.4 at 1M, 0.8 at 3M). A Kronos strategy with a ~12-day horizon (about 20 turnovers a year) could run only a minority of its trades in NISA. This matters only for a low-turnover, long-only stock/ETF variant.

title: Compute cost of a Kronos walk-forward and where to run it

research.topic: Phase 0 compute feasibility: Kronos-small daily walk-forward (lookback 40, horizon 12, N=10/100 paths) on laptop CPU, Kaggle, Colab, Modal, RunPod; fit within JPY 3,000/month
research.summary:
The upstream inference loop (commit 67b630e) has no KV cache. Each of the 12 generated bars re-runs the whole 40-51-token window through all 8 decoder blocks. That pass is followed by one light cross-attention layer and the s2 head, which reuse the context, so it is not a second full pass. The N sample paths are folded into the batch by copying the input N times, and only their mean is returned. Cost is 26.0 GFLOP per sample path (analytic 25.96; 25.99 counted by torch FlopCounterMode on a re-implementation with identical layer shapes and identical parameter counts). That is 260 GFLOP per instrument-day at N=10 and 2.6 TFLOP at N=100. The tokenizer is 1.4% of the cost.

Measured on the laptop CPU: about 250 ms per path under sustained load (about 100 GFLOPS effective). GPU throughput is assumed, not measured: T4 2.0 TFLOPS effective in FP32 (25% of peak), L4 4.0 (13% of peak, limited by memory bandwidth), and Kaggle's T4 x2 counted as about one L4. Kaggle retired the P100 in September 2026.

One walk-forward year takes, centrally: U=500 N=100 about 22 L4 / T4x2 hours; U=1,600 N=100 about 71 h; U=4,000 N=100 about 177 h; every N=10 case 18 h or less. Pessimistic figures are double these.

Free Kaggle (about 30 h/week of T4 x2) covers everything except U=4,000 at N=100 within roughly a month per walk-forward year. Colab Pay As You Go on an L4 costs about ¥20/h, so ¥2,358 buys about 117 L4-hours a month. Within ¥3,000/month: all universes at N=10, and U≤500 at N=100, fit comfortably. U=1,600 at N=100 is borderline (weeks of quota per walk-forward year). U=4,000 at N=100 does not fit without a KV cache or bf16, or spreading the work over 2-3 months.

Recommended plan: Kaggle T4 x2 as the primary platform, launched headless with `kaggle kernels push`. Batch instrument-days and sample paths together at about 2,000-4,000 rows per GPU call, with one process per GPU and date chunks under 12 h. Colab Pro or Pay As You Go on an L4 is the overflow. First, a 10-minute calibration run on Kaggle replaces the assumed GPU throughput with a measured one.
research.findings_md:
# Kronos-small daily walk-forward: compute cost and platforms (Phase 0, as of 2026-11-08)

Scope and method:
- Read-only research. No accounts were created.
- I read upstream `kronos.py`, `module.py` and both configs at commit 67b630e.
- I derived FLOPs analytically and checked them with `torch.utils.flop_counter`.
- The laptop CPU was benchmarked inside an isolated venv (`<scratch>/phase0/bench/venv`, torch 2.15.0+cpu).
- The harness blocked executing the downloaded upstream code. The benchmark therefore uses my own re-implementation (`<scratch>/phase0/bench/bench_kronos.py`). It has the same layer shapes and the same no-cache loop, with random weights; parameter counts match exactly.
- Tables are produced by `<scratch>/phase0/bench/calc_tables.py 250`.
- I deliberately did not look up the USD/JPY rate, because USD/JPY may be a candidate market and its 2024-07 to 2026-10 prices are sealed. USD prices are converted at an assumed ¥150/USD; scale linearly.

## 1. What the inference code does (upstream @67b630e)

| Question | Answer | Code |
|---|---|---|
| KV cache? | **No.** Each of the 12 steps passes the full window (`pre_buffer[:, :window_len]`, 40→51 tokens) to `decode_s1`, which runs all 8 blocks from scratch. The attention has no cache arguments. That is 546 token-passes per path; a cache would need 51. | kronos.py:420-436; module.py:330-353 |
| Decoder passes per bar | **1 full 8-block pass** (`decode_s1`), then **1 DependencyAwareLayer** (a single 4-head cross-attention plus RMSNorm) and the s2 head (`decode_s2`). The s2 step reuses the `decode_s1` context, so it is not a second full pass; it is about 4.5% of a step's FLOPs. Both heads project every position although only the last one is used. | kronos.py:278-328, 436-442; module.py:446-462 |
| How the N paths are batched | The input is repeated N times and becomes batch rows B·N. The tokenizer encodes N identical copies, and the paths share no computation. Cost is linear in N. **Only the mean over the N paths is returned**: per-path quantiles need a patch to line 467, or open PR #393's `return_paths`. | kronos.py:394-398, 465-467 |
| Sampling at top_p=1.0, top_k=0 | Filtering is skipped, so there is no sort. Each bar takes two softmax + multinomial draws over a 1,024-token vocabulary. | kronos.py:373-386, 438-442 |
| Tokenizer cost | 3 encoder + 3 decoder blocks at d=256 (`n_*_layers-1`). Encode runs on 40 bars × B·N rows and decode on 52 tokens. Together about 0.36 GFLOP per path (1.4%). | kronos.py:59-68, 142-177, 459-464; config_tokenizer.json |
| Batching across series | `predict_batch` needs equal lookback and `pred_len`. With a fixed 40/12, instrument-days from different dates can share one batch, because walk-forward days are independent. | kronos.py:642-646 |
| Precision / context | FP32, no autocast. With 40+12 = 52 tokens, the 512-token context limit is never reached, so the window never slides. | kronos.py:484, 510-512 |

Model size: Kronos-small has 24,741,376 parameters and Kronos-Tokenizer-base 3,958,042. Hugging Face weights:
- `NeoQuasar/Kronos-small` @901c26c1332695a2a8f243eb2f37243a37bea320, 98,980,656 B, FP32, MIT.
- `NeoQuasar/Kronos-Tokenizer-base` @0e0117387f39004a9016484a186a908917e22426, 15,842,368 B, MIT.
- These are the same revisions pinned by upstream's tests; pin them in the pre-registration.

## 2. FLOPs per forecast

Assumptions:
- A GEMM costs 2 × MACs.
- Attention QKᵀ and AV are counted over the full L×L matrix, with no causal discount.
- Norms, RoPE, softmax and sampling are memory-bound. They are left out of the FLOP count and covered by the utilisation factor instead.
- 245 trading days a year (an FX market with about 260 weekdays would be about 6% more).

| Component per sample path | GFLOP |
|---|---|
| 8 decoder blocks × 546 token-passes (Σ L, L=40..51) | 22.90 |
| Self-attention scores (QKᵀ + AV) | 0.41 |
| Fusion projection, s1 head, s2 K/V projection, s2 head (all positions) | 2.29 |
| Tokenizer encode (40 bars) + decode (52 tokens) | 0.36 |
| **Total** | **25.96** (FlopCounterMode: 25.99) |

Totals:
- Per instrument-day: **N=10: 260 GFLOP; N=100: 2.60 TFLOP.**
- Per instrument per year: 63.6 TFLOP at N=10; 636 TFLOP at N=100.
- With a KV cache, the decoder token-passes drop from 546 to 51 per path (10.7×). Sharing the prefix across the N paths and computing only last-position heads would give about 7-20× fewer total FLOPs. This is an analytic estimate, not measured.

## 3. Throughput assumptions (effective FP32, large batches, upstream code)

| Platform | Peak FP32 / memory bandwidth | Assumed effective (central; pessimistic-optimistic) | ms per path | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Laptop i7-1355U (10 cores / 12 threads, AVX2, no AVX-512, 15 W) | n/a | **~0.10 TFLOPS** (0.087-0.15) | **250** (170-300) | **Measured**: 137-170 ms/path in short runs; 232-274 ms/path sustained at 200-1,000 rows; other processes were competing |
| T4 (one GPU) | 8.1 TFLOPS / 320 GB/s, 70 W | 2.0 TFLOPS (1.0-3.4) = 25% of peak | 13 | Roofline about 3.4 TFLOPS (GEMMs about 4.5 TFLOPS sustained plus 0.48 GB/path of elementwise traffic), discounted |
| Kaggle T4 x2 (both GPUs, two processes) | 2 × T4 | 4.0 (2.0-6.8) | 6.5 | 2 × T4 |
| P100 (Kaggle; **retired 2026-09**) | 9.3 / 732 GB/s | 3.5 (2.0-6.0) = 38% | 7.4 | Roofline about 6 TFLOPS, discounted |
| L4 (Colab) | 30.3 / **300 GB/s**, 72 W | 4.0 (2.0-7.0) = 13% | 6.5 | Elementwise ops are bandwidth-bound and as slow as on the T4, so only the GEMM time shrinks |

The discount below the roofline is deliberate. Upstream PRs #174 and #192 report about 3.4-4 TFLOPS effective for this uncached FP32 code on an **A100** at batch 32 (about 18-22% of its FP32 peak); their units are ambiguous. The GPU rows are the biggest uncertainty here. Running the calibration script on the target GPU would settle them (section 7).

## 5. Platform facts

**Kaggle (free)**
- Weekly GPU quota: "The quota resets weekly and is 30 hours or sometimes higher depending on demand and resources" (docs/efficient-gpu-usage). The current figure is shown in account settings.
- Sessions: 12 h execution for CPU and GPU sessions (9 h for TPU). T4 x2 means 2 T4 GPUs, 4 CPU cores and 29 GB RAM. /kaggle/working gives 20 GB that persists; there may be a queue at busy times (docs/notebooks).
- Idle timeout: the notebooks doc says 20 min and the GPU doc says 60 min. This only affects interactive sessions; Save & Run All runs in batch.
- **P100 retired**: Kaggle CLI PR #1192 (merged 2026-09-11) lists NvidiaTeslaP100 as retired, and P100 requests are silently run on T4 x2. The CLI docs' "Accelerators available as of Sep 2026" list T4 x2 as the default GPU and omit the P100. Earlier, on 2026-07-30, the docs had warned that the P100 was unusable on the default image, whose PyTorch 2.10 cu128 build lacks sm_60 kernels (Kaggle/docker-python issue #1546). T4 works natively.
- Headless launch: `kaggle kernels push` with kernel-metadata.json (`enable_gpu`, `enable_internet`, `machine_shape: "NvidiaTeslaT4"`) or `--accelerator NvidiaTeslaT4`.
- Internet: the docs say Internet is enabled in the Settings pane, and is on by default for a new notebook. The docs do not mention phone verification. Community threads report that the GPU and Internet toggles appear only after phone verification of the account. Treat that as likely, not confirmed.
- Alternative to internet: the MIT-licensed weights (115 MB) can be uploaded as a private Kaggle dataset and attached with `dataset_sources`.
- Promotion (docs/notebooks, "experimental", "limited time"; the end date may not be announced): Colab Pro and Pro+ subscribers who link their account get **+15 / +30 Kaggle GPU hours per week**.
- Unknown: whether a T4 x2 session uses quota at 1 h per session-hour; third-party sources say the pool is shared.

**Google Colab**
- Prices from the official pricing page as served to a Japanese IP on 2026-11-08, tax-inclusive (Pro+ is ¥5,243 before tax):

| Plan | Price | Compute units (CU) |

## 7. Recommended run plan

1. **Calibrate (¥0, about 10 min):** run `bench_kronos.py` on a Kaggle T4 session, and optionally with `--bf16` and on a Colab L4. It uses CUDA automatically, needs only torch, uses random weights and no market data. It prints ms/path, effective TFLOPS and peak GPU memory. Replace the section 3 assumptions with these measurements before pre-registering. Then run upstream `predict_batch` once with the pinned real weights to confirm equivalence.
2. **Primary platform: Kaggle T4 x2, free.**
   - Phone-verify the account, which is likely needed for GPU and internet.
   - Launch headless from the laptop with `kaggle kernels push --accelerator NvidiaTeslaT4`. Never request a P100.
   - Attach the pinned weights as a private dataset, or let the notebook download them with internet on.
3. **Batching:**
   - Flatten (instrument, day) pairs into rows. Use B×N ≈ 2,000-4,000 rows per call per 16 GB T4, confirming against peak memory: N=10 means 200-400 instrument-days per call; N=100 means 20-40.
   - Run one Python process per GPU (`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0` and `=1`), each taking half the date range.
   - Chunk the run by date (for example, one quarter per job) so each job finishes in under about 11 h, with resumable outputs in /kaggle/working.
   - Store per-forecast summaries, not raw paths. Raw close-only N=100 paths for U=4,000 come to about 4.7 GB per year in FP32.
4. **Overflow:**
   - Colab Pro (¥1,179/month: 100 CU, plus +15 Kaggle GPU h/week while the promotion lasts) or Pay As You Go 100-CU packs (¥1,179, 90-day expiry).
   - Use an L4 via `colab run --gpu L4 job.py` with a positive balance.
   - Modal (free $30/month credit) and RunPod (L4 $0.44/h) only as further fallbacks; they cost about 3-8× more per GPU-hour than Colab.
5. **Laptop:** development and U≤30 N=10 smoke tests only.
6. **Decide before pre-registration:**
   - N: 100 costs 10× as much as 10, and upstream returns only the mean.
   - Whether path-level outputs are needed (requires a patch).
   - Whether to adopt the KV cache (exact-equivalence test first) or bf16 (changes numerics).
   - Pin the hardware type, torch version and seeds. Sampled outputs are not bit-identical across CPU and GPU types.
conclusions: Upstream Kronos inference (67b630e) has no KV cache: each of the 12 generated bars re-runs the full 40-51-token window through all 8 blocks. That is 546 token-passes per path versus 51 with a cache.

Each generated bar takes one full 8-block pass (decode_s1) plus one light cross-attention layer and the s2 head (decode_s2) on the reused context. It is not two full passes; the s2 step is about 4.5% of a step's FLOPs.
The N paths are batched as B·N rows by copying the input. Cost is linear in N, and only the mean over the paths is returned (kronos.py:467).
Cost is 26.0 GFLOP per sample path (tokenizer 1.4%): 260 GFLOP per instrument-day at N=10 and 2.6 TFLOP at N=100.
Laptop i7-1355U measured about 250 ms per path sustained (about 100 GFLOPS effective). That is practical only for U≤30 at N=10 (5 h per walk-forward year).

claims.claim: Upstream autoregressive inference has no KV cache. At every one of the pred_len steps, the full current window (pre_buffer[:, :window_len], 40→51 tokens here) is passed to model.decode_s1, which runs all 8 TransformerBlocks from scratch. The attention modules take no cache arguments.

Each generated bar takes one full 8-block pass (decode_s1) plus one DependencyAwareLayer (a single 4-head cross-attention over the reused context, plus RMSNorm) and the s2 head (decode_s2). It is not two full passes. Both the s1 and s2 heads are projected over every position, but only the last position's logits are used.

The N sample paths are batched by repeating each series N times into B·N rows, and the tokenizer encodes all N identical copies. Paths share no computation, so cost is linear in N. Only the mean over the N paths is returned (np.mean over the sample axis).
With top_k=0 and top_p=1.0, top-k/top-p filtering is skipped (no sort). Each bar takes two softmax + multinomial draws over a 1,024-way vocabulary (s1 and s2).

checks.correction: This holds only when top_p=1.0 is passed explicitly. KronosPredictor.predict defaults to top_p=0.9 and auto_regressive_inference defaults to 0.99, so with the defaults the sort-based filter does run.

claims.claim: predict_batch requires all series to have the same history length and pred_len. With a fixed 40/12, instrument-days from different dates can share one batch.

Kronos-Tokenizer-base has 3,958,042 (d_model 256, ff 512, 4 heads, 3 encoder + 3 decoder blocks). Both counts were reproduced exactly by instantiating a re-implementation with identical layer shapes.
